```markdown
# Spokojny Świat Artura

A calm, silent Polish-language web app for three-year-old Artur. A main menu with large picture tiles opens gentle, touch-driven activities, each with a Back button. **Intended for supervised use by a young child.**

**Try it live: [Spokojny Świat Artura](https://bielinskilukasz.github.io/child-page/)**

## Activities
Full documentation for every activity is in [docs/activities/](docs/activities/README.md); each item below links to its page.

1. [**Akwarium Artura**](docs/activities/akwarium-artura.md) – Drop food into a calm aquarium for the fish and make them blow soft bubbles.
2. [**Magiczny Ogród**](docs/activities/magiczny-ogrod.md) – Touch a meadow to grow flowers and mushrooms under changing weather and light.

All activities are silent and calm, with no scores or failure, and work with touch, mouse or stylus. The Back button in the top-left corner returns to the menu. Parents can hide or reorder activities in Settings; see [Menu activities](#menu-activities).

## Run locally
Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step:

```
python3 -m http.server 8000
```
then open http://localhost:8000/. Navigation uses URL hashes and relative paths, so it works from any subpath.

## Install and offline use
The app is an installable PWA (manifest, icons, service worker); it needs HTTPS (GitHub Pages) or localhost.
- **Android Chrome:** open the site, menu ⋮ → **Zainstaluj aplikację** / *Install app*. It opens full-screen from the home-screen icon.
- **iPhone/iPad Safari:** Share → **Do ekranu początkowego** / *Add to Home Screen*.
- **Offline:** after one online load, the menu and all activities work in airplane mode. The service worker (`sw.js`) is network-first, so a new deployment is picked up on the next launch with network; no version bump is needed.
- **Old shortcut:** if a "shortcut" saved before this change misbehaves, remove it once (long-press the icon → remove/uninstall) and install again.
- Icons are generated by `python3 tools/make-icons.py`.

## Deployment
Pushing to `main` runs `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, which publishes to GitHub Pages. In the repo settings set Pages → Source to **GitHub Actions** once.

## Browser support
Mandatory manual tests: Chrome desktop, Chrome Android, Safari iPhone/iPad. Edge and Firefox should work. Zoom is intentionally disabled to avoid accidental pinch-zoom.

## Privacy
No backend, cookies, ads, third-party requests or tracking; no network request is made for analytics. The only things stored, locally on the device (localStorage), are the parent-configured daily playtime limit, the playtime used today (with its date), which activities are shown in the menu, in what order and which are favourites, and the anonymous usage statistics described below; none of it leaves the device. No audio.

## Usage statistics
`js/analytics.js` (`window.Analytics`) is the single module through which every activity reports usage; nothing is shown to the child. It keeps only **daily aggregates** for the last 90 days plus running all-time totals (localStorage key `swa.stats`), never per-event history, names, age, location, text or any device fingerprint. The per-session id is random and kept in memory only.

Measured: sessions (a session ends when the app is closed or after 30 minutes hidden), active vs. inactive time (active = page visible and a touch/key/pointer less than 60 s ago), activity starts, active time, completions, replays (re-opening in the same session), exits before completion, quick exits (within 10 s), touches, the highest level reached in the levelled activities, and **interaction variants** reported as aggregate counts only (for example the dog breed, the rocket part, the letter, the scoop or tip, the machine or the product). Nothing per-event, personal or networked is stored. See [docs/activities/README.md](docs/activities/README.md) for the per-activity status.

Every activity gets starts, active time, replays, quick exits and touches automatically (group c). Groups: (a) completion is defined, (b) interaction variants only, (c) automatic tracking only. Beyond that, these activities call `window.Analytics` themselves:

| Activity | What it reports | Completions |
|---|---|---|
| Puzzle, Pamięć, Kolorowe Kształty, Policz Razem | levels (`levelStart`, `levelComplete`) and `complete()` | (a) yes, with exit-before-completion and highest level |
| Literki | letter shown (`levelStart`) and letter touched (`track('interaction')`) | (b) no, interaction variants only |
| Plac Budowy, Lot na Smoku, Rasy Piesków | machine operated / steering touch, fire puff and lit lantern / dog touch and navigation with the breed (`track('interaction')`) | (b) no, interaction variants only |
| Psia Myjnia, Wyścig Piesków, Aport, Nakarm Pieska, Koparka, Zbuduj Rakietę, Zakupy, Latarka | interaction variants (breed, scoop/tip, part/launch, product) plus `complete()` per round | (a) yes, per round, but the activity stays open-ended |
| Mieszanie Kolorów | each blob drop (`track('interaction')`, variant = colour) plus `complete()` per mix | (a) yes, per mix, but the activity stays open-ended |
| Lustro | see [docs/activities/README.md](docs/activities/README.md#analytics-status) | each glow-and-next picture |
| Od Jajka do… | interaction variants (cycle and stage) plus `complete()` per cycle | (a) yes, per cycle, but the activity stays open-ended |
| Pizza | interaction variant = topping or oven, per placement or oven touch | (a) yes, `complete()` per served pizza |
| Ślady na Piasku | see [docs/activities/README.md](docs/activities/README.md#analytics-status) | each uncovered picture |
| Kulkowy Tor | see [docs/activities/README.md](docs/activities/README.md#analytics-status) | each ball in the basket |
| Nalej Wody | interaction variants (glass size at each pour start, `<size>-full` per filled glass) plus `complete()` per full set | (a) yes, per full set, but the activity stays open-ended |
| Wędkowanie | catch kind per lowering (`track('interaction')`) plus `complete()` per five catches | (a) yes, per set of five, but the activity stays open-ended |
| Mój Dzień | each scene start (`interaction`, variant = tile) | each set of four scenes seen (`complete()`) |
| Naklejki | interaction variant = sticker, per placement | (b) no, the activity is open-ended |
| Rozmiar | interaction variants (item size) plus `complete()` per stack | (a) yes, per stack, but the activity stays open-ended |

All other activities use only the automatic tracking (c) and are open-ended. When an activity starts calling `Analytics`, add or update its row in this table and in the analytics status of [docs/activities/README.md](docs/activities/README.md).

To view it: gear icon, parent gate, Settings, **Statystyki** (app metrics, ranking by active time, other rankings; filter: this session, today, 7 days, 30 days, all time). The same screen exports all stored aggregates as JSON (download or copy) and has "Wyzeruj statystyki" (with confirmation) to delete everything.

## Playtime limit
A gear icon on the main menu opens a parent gate (a simple sum) and then Settings: daily limit in minutes (default 20, or no limit) and a timer reset. The timer counts only visible activity time and resets each new day. An hourglass (no numbers) shows time left, content dims gently over the last 20%, and when time is up a sleeping-moon screen is shown.

## Menu activities
In Settings (behind the same gate) a parent can enable or disable each activity and reorder them with up/down buttons; "Przywróć domyślne" restores all of them in the original order. At least one activity always stays enabled, and disabled activities cannot be opened by any route (a stored or typed `#hash` shows the menu).

**Favourites.** Each Settings row also has a star toggle (filled ★ = favourite, outlined ☆ = not). Enabled favourites appear in an "Ulubione" section above the other tiles, in their saved list order, and are not repeated below; with no enabled favourites no heading is shown. A disabled activity is hidden even if starred and returns to the section when re-enabled. Only a parent can change favourites (the child has no control); they are stored locally with the menu configuration and "Przywróć domyślne" clears them. Starring is not reported to usage statistics.

## Randomisation helper
`js/animals.js` (loaded after `random.js`) exposes `window.Animals`, the shared animal family drawn in one round-head style (13 animals: Miś, Króliczek, Kotek, Piesek, Myszka, Świnka, Lisek, Lew, Słoń, Panda, Żabka, Sowa, Koala): `Animals.head(id, opts)` returns the SVG markup, `Animals.pick(n, {distinct})` returns `n` random unique animals (`distinct` avoids alike silhouettes). Pociąg, Dobranoc, Farma, Chowany, Cienie, Autobusik and Buźki pick their animals from it on every launch, in memory only.

`js/random.js` (loaded before the activities) exposes `window.Rand` for activity variety, kept in memory only (nothing stored, nothing scored): `Rand.shuffle(list)` returns a new shuffled copy; `Rand.pick(list, n)` returns `n` unique items (the whole pool shuffled if `n` exceeds it); `Rand.pickOne(list, key)` returns one item that differs from the previous result for the same `key` in this page session when the pool has 2+ entries. An empty pool gives `[]` / `undefined`.

## Activity documentation
One document per activity (purpose, flow, rules, configuration, risks, technical details, manual test scenarios) is in [docs/activities/](docs/activities/README.md); new ones start from the [template](docs/activities/ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE.md). A new activity adds one linked one-line item to the Activities list above (details live only in its document) and its row to the docs index; the intro carries no count. Items marked "(planned)" are placeholders with a stub page; filling one follows the rules in [Planned activities](docs/activities/README.md#planned-activities).

```

```css
.aquarium { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; touch-action: none;
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
.garden { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: #cfe8f8; }
.g-sky { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 45% 0; background: linear-gradient(#bfe0f6, #dff1fb); }
.g-lawn { position: absolute; inset: 55% 0 0 0; background: linear-gradient(#bfe6b4, #a8d9a0); border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 18px 18px 0 0; }
.g-lawn:focus-visible, .g-cloud:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: -4px; }
.g-wx { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
.g-wx i { position: absolute; display: block; }
.garden.tod-night { background: #1d2a5c; }
.garden.tod-night .g-sky { background: linear-gradient(#1d2a5c, #3b4a8c); }
.garden.tod-night .g-lawn { background: linear-gradient(#6aa88a, #55967c); }
.garden.tod-night .g-plant svg { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, .9)); }
.garden.wx-cloudy .g-sky, .garden.wx-rain .g-sky { background: linear-gradient(#b4c3cf, #d2dce3); }
.garden.wx-cloudy.tod-night .g-sky, .garden.wx-rain.tod-night .g-sky { background: linear-gradient(#2a3361, #424d80); }
.garden.wx-rain .g-lawn { filter: saturate(.85); }
.g-orb { width: clamp(56px, 12vw, 110px); aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; right: 9%; top: 8%;
  background: #ffe48a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(255, 228, 138, .35), 0 0 30px 14px rgba(255, 228, 138, .35); }
.garden.tod-night .g-orb { background: #f4f1da; box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(244, 241, 218, .2), 0 0 24px 8px rgba(244, 241, 218, .25); }
.g-star { border-radius: 50%; background: #f4f1ff; animation: g-twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes g-twinkle { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .45; } }
.g-bank { height: clamp(34px, 8vw, 64px); border-radius: 40px; background: #eef2f5; box-shadow: 30px -14px 0 4px #eef2f5, 70px -4px 0 0 #eef2f5; }
.g-bank1 { width: 24%; left: 8%; top: 24%; }
.g-bank2 { width: 20%; left: 56%; top: 12%; }
.garden.wx-cloudy .g-bank, .garden.wx-rain .g-bank { background: #cfd8de; box-shadow: 30px -14px 0 4px #cfd8de, 70px -4px 0 0 #cfd8de; }
.garden.tod-night .g-bank { background: #5b668f; box-shadow: 30px -14px 0 4px #5b668f, 70px -4px 0 0 #5b668f; }
.g-drop { width: 7px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; top: -20px; background: #8ec5ea; opacity: .85; animation: g-fall 1.1s linear infinite; }
.garden.tod-night .g-drop { background: #bcd6f2; }
@keyframes g-fall { from { transform: translateY(0); } to { transform: translateY(105vh); } }
.g-wind { left: 0; width: 22%; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .7); animation: g-gust 7s linear infinite; }
.garden.tod-night .g-wind { background: rgba(220, 230, 255, .5); }
@keyframes g-gust { from { transform: translateX(-30vw); } to { transform: translateX(125vw); } }
.g-plants { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.g-plant { position: absolute; width: calc(60px * var(--s) * 1.4); height: calc(100px * var(--s) * 1.4);
  transform: translate(-50%, -100%); max-height: 30vh; transition: opacity .9s ease; pointer-events: none; }
.g-plant svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.g-plant.fading { opacity: 0; }
.g-plant .g-stem, .g-plant .g-leaves, .g-plant .g-bloom { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.g-plant .g-seed { animation: g-seed 3.6s ease-out both; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.g-plant .g-stem { animation: g-grow 2s ease-out .5s both; }
.g-plant .g-leaves { transform-origin: 50% 50%; animation: g-pop 1.2s ease-out 1.8s both; }
.g-plant .g-bloom { transform-origin: 50% 75%; animation: g-pop 1.6s ease-out 2.6s both; }
@keyframes g-seed { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.4); } 15% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 70% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes g-grow { from { transform: scaleY(0); } to { transform: scaleY(1); } }
@keyframes g-pop { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.2); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
.g-cloud { position: absolute; top: 12%; left: 0; width: clamp(120px, 26vw, 240px); padding: 12px; margin: -12px;
  animation: g-drift 80s linear infinite; cursor: pointer; z-index: 99999; }
.g-cloud svg { width: 100%; display: block; opacity: .95; }
@keyframes g-drift { from { transform: translateX(-120%); } to { transform: translateX(calc(100vw + 20px)); } }
.garden.paused *, .garden.paused { animation-play-state: paused !important; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .g-seed { display: none; } * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }
.night { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  justify-content: center; padding: 64px 0 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, #2a3a74, #141c45 70%);
  touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; color: #f4f1ff; }
.n-sky { position: relative; width: min(94vw, calc(100vh - 76px)); width: min(94vw, calc(100dvh - 76px));
  aspect-ratio: 1; flex: none; transition: opacity .8s ease; }
.n-sky.fade { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .n-lines { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }

.n-line.on { stroke-dashoffset: 0; transition: stroke-dashoffset .9s ease-out; }
.n-fill { fill: rgba(255, 233, 168, 0); transition: fill 1.6s ease; }
.done .n-fill { fill: rgba(255, 233, 168, .18); }
.done .n-line { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255, 233, 168, .8)); }
.n-star { position: absolute; width: 56px; height: 56px; min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; margin: -28px 0 0 -28px;
  padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; }
.n-star::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: -11px;
  border-radius: 50%; background: #aab6e8; opacity: .6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(170, 182, 232, .15); }
.n-star.on::before { background: #fff3c4; opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 14px 6px rgba(255, 233, 168, .6);
  animation: n-pulse 3.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.n-star:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #cbbcff; outline-offset: -4px; }
@keyframes n-pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.18); } }
.n-msg { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity .8s ease, visibility 0s .8s; }
.n-msg.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transition: opacity .8s ease; }
.n-bravo { position: absolute; top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 14px); left: 72px; right: 72px; margin: 0; text-align: center;
  font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 5vw, 2.2rem); font-weight: 700; text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20, 28, 69, .8); }
.n-next { position: absolute; right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 12px); bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); pointer-events: auto;
  min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; padding: .3rem 1.1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffe9a8;
  color: #3a3566; font: inherit; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; }
.n-next:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #cbbcff; outline-offset: 3px; }
.night.paused *, .night.paused { animation-play-state: paused !important; }
.dn { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; --p: 0; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#bfe0f6, #e2f3fc); }
.dn-night { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(#1c2658, #2f3a78); opacity: var(--p); }
.dn-stars { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 40% 0; opacity: var(--p); pointer-events: none; }
.dn-stars i { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; background: #f4f1ff; opacity: .8; }
.dn-fly { position: absolute; width: 3.5px; height: 3.5px; margin: -1.75px 0 0 -1.75px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, .6); }
.dn-fly { opacity: 1; }
.dn-fly.plane { --pulse: 0; background: #9a9fae; box-shadow: 0 0 calc(2px + var(--pulse) * 5px) rgba(255, 70, 70, calc(var(--pulse) * .85)); }
.dn-fly.plane::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff4646; opacity: var(--pulse); }
.dn-bird { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: clamp(56px, 9vmin, 72px); min-height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: none; will-change: transform; z-index: 3; opacity: calc(1 - var(--p) * 2); }
.dn-bird svg { width: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.dn-bird:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 50%; }
.dn-clouds { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.dn-cloud { position: absolute; left: 0; width: var(--w, 24vmin); will-change: transform; opacity: calc(.95 - var(--p) * .55); }
.dn-cloud svg { width: 100%; display: block; }
.dn-body { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 42%; width: clamp(150px, 38vmin, 320px); aspect-ratio: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border: 0; padding: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; }
.dn-body svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.dn-sun { opacity: calc(1 - var(--p)); }
.dn-moon { opacity: var(--p); }
.dn-body:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 6px; border-radius: 50%; }
.tp { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#cfe8f8, #eaf6fb 60%); }
.tp-sun { position: absolute; top: 9%; right: 12%; width: clamp(48px, 10vw, 90px); aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff1bd; box-shadow: 0 0 40px 16px rgba(255, 241, 189, .6); }
.stage .tp-hills { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 55%; display: block; }
.tp-ground { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(var(--ty) - 6px); bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(#a8d9a0, #bfe6b4); }
.tp-track { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(var(--ty) - 4px); height: 14px; border-top: 4px solid #8a84a8;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #b59d86 0 10px, transparent 10px 28px) 0 100% / 100% 6px no-repeat; }
.tp-station { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: calc(var(--ty) - var(--th) * 1.9); width: calc(var(--tw) * .6); height: calc(var(--th) * 1.9);
  transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
.stage .tp-station svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.tp-station:focus-visible, .tp-train:focus-visible, .tp-ab:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 12px; }
.tp-train { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--tw); height: var(--th); cursor: pointer; z-index: 2; will-change: transform; }
.stage .tp-train svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.tp-ab { position: absolute; top: 4%; width: 22%; height: 66%; min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
.tp-ab[data-i="0"] { left: 2.5%; } .tp-ab[data-i="1"] { left: 27.5%; } .tp-ab[data-i="2"] { left: 52.5%; }
.tp-puffs { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 3; }
.tp-puff { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; opacity: 0; will-change: transform, opacity; }
.bm { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#d6ecfb, #eef7fd 70%, #f4eefb); }
.bm-b { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform, opacity; opacity: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 28%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .85) 0 7%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 22%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(var(--c), .08) 55%, rgba(var(--c), .45) 100%);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(var(--c), .55), inset 0 -6px 14px rgba(var(--c), .35); }

/* Dobranoc */
.db { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
  padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 56px) calc(var(--safe-r) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-l) + 8px);
  background: #6f6aa8; box-sizing: border-box; }
.db-board { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px) * 4 / 3));
  border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; }
.stage .db-scene, .stage .db-glow { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.db-glow-wrap { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .db-btn { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0;
  border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .db-btn svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.db-btn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #8f7fd1; }
.r-scene { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; background: linear-gradient(#cfeaf7, #eaf5fb 60%); overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
.r-box { position: relative; width: min(94vw, calc(100dvh - 110px)); aspect-ratio: 1; margin-top: 60px; }
.r-meadow { position: absolute; left: -100vw; right: -100vw; top: 72%; height: 100vh; background: linear-gradient(#bfe6b4, #a8d9a0); border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 24px 24px 0 0; }
.r-puddle { position: absolute; aspect-ratio: 3 / 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; background: #b5dcf5; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #d6ecfa; }
.r-ripple { position: absolute; width: 14%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 1; border: 2px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(.2); pointer-events: none; }
.r-drop { position: absolute; width: 7px; height: 12px; margin: -6px 0 0 -3px; border-radius: 50%; background: #8ec5ea; opacity: .85; pointer-events: none; }
.r-rainbow { position: absolute; left: 4%; right: 4%; top: 30%; aspect-ratio: 200 / 110; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .r-rainbow svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.r-cloud { position: absolute; min-width: 96px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; z-index: 2; }
.stage .r-cloud svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 4px rgba(120, 150, 190, .25)); }
.r-cloud:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 30px; }

/* Kolorowe Kształty */
.ks { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#f3eefb, #e2f3dc); }
.ks-glow { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, rgba(255, 233, 168, .75), rgba(255, 233, 168, 0) 70%); }
.ks-field { position: absolute; --ks-s: 96px;
  top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 12px);
  bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 12px); }
.stage .ks-item { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--ks-s); height: var(--ks-s); min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px;
  padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; will-change: transform; }
.stage .ks-item svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .ks-outline { cursor: default; }
.stage .ks-shape:disabled { cursor: default; }
.stage .ks-shape { z-index: 1; }
.ks-item:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 24px; }
.ks-selected { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 24px; }

/* Koraliki */
.kr { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#fdf0d5, #e6e0f7); }
.kr-glow { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.kr-field { position: absolute; --kr-s: 64px;
  top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 12px);
  bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 12px); }
.stage .kr-deco { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; overflow: visible; }
.stage .kr-bead { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--kr-s); height: var(--kr-s); min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px;
  padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; will-change: transform; z-index: 1; }
.stage .kr-bead svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .kr-string { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; z-index: 0; cursor: default; }
.kr-bead:focus-visible, .kr-string:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 24px; }
.kr-selected { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 24px; }

/* Zwierzątka na Farmie */
.fm { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
  padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 56px) calc(var(--safe-r) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-l) + 8px);
  background: #e8f4fb; box-sizing: border-box; }
.fm-board { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px) * 4 / 3));
  border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; }
.stage .fm-board > svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .fm-btn { position: absolute; aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none;
  cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .fm-btn svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.fm-btn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 24px; }

/* Policz Razem */
.pr { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
  padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 56px) calc(var(--safe-r) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-l) + 8px);
  background: #e8f4fb; box-sizing: border-box; }
.pr-board { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px) * 4 / 3));
  border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; }
.pr-layer { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.stage .pr-board > svg, .stage .pr-layer > svg.pr-row { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .pr-btn { position: absolute; width: 21%; aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none;
  cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .pr-btn svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.pr-btn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 24px; }

/* Ubierz Misia */
.um { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 56px) calc(var(--safe-r) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-l) + 8px);
  background: #f3eefb; box-sizing: border-box; }
.um-board { position: relative; --um-s: 56px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px) * 4 / 3)); }
.um-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; }
.stage .um-bg svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.stage .um-hit { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 1;
  touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.um-window { left: 5%; top: 5%; width: 33%; height: 40%; }
.um-bearbtn { left: 24%; top: 33%; width: 35%; height: 58%; }
.stage .um-item { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--um-s); height: var(--um-s); min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; z-index: 10;
  padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; will-change: transform; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .um-item svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .um-item[data-id='boots'].um-worn svg { transform: scale(1.4); }
.um-hit:focus-visible, .um-item:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 20px; }
.um-selected { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 20px; }

/* Cienie */

.sa-cloud { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--cw); aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; min-width: 96px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; will-change: transform; }

.sa-plane { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--pw); height: var(--ph); cursor: pointer; z-index: 2; will-change: transform; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
.stage .sa-plane svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.sa-pbtn { position: absolute; left: 49%; top: 18%; width: 24%; height: 48%; min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; cursor: pointer; transform: translate(-6%, -6%); }
.sa-plane:focus-visible, .sa-cloud:focus-visible, .sa-pbtn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 14px; }
.sa-apt { position: absolute; right: 4%; bottom: calc(100% - var(--ry) + 2px); width: clamp(70px, 16vw, 130px); height: auto; pointer-events: none; }
/* weather: decoration only, thin and translucent, below the clouds and the plane */
.sa-wx { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; z-index: 0; }
.sa-drop { position: absolute; width: 3px; height: 18px; border-radius: 2px; background: #7fa3c9; opacity: .5; animation: sa-fall linear infinite; }
.sa-flake { position: absolute; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; opacity: .9; animation: sa-fall linear infinite; }
@keyframes sa-fall { from { transform: translateY(-12vh); } to { transform: translateY(112vh); } }
.sa-w-cloudy { background: linear-gradient(#c3cfdd, #dfe5ee 62%, #ece8f3); }
.sa-w-rain { background: linear-gradient(#b3c2d6, #d0d9e6 62%, #e3e4f0); }
.sa-w-snow { background: linear-gradient(#d4e1f1, #e9f0f9 62%, #f1eef8); }
.sa-w-cloudy .sa-sun, .sa-w-rain .sa-sun, .sa-w-snow .sa-sun { opacity: .3; }
.sa-w-cloudy .sa-cloud svg g { fill: #f3f5fa; }
.sa-w-rain .sa-cloud svg g { fill: #e4e8f1; }
.sa-puffs { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; }
.sa-puff { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; opacity: 0; will-change: transform, opacity; }
.tk { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#cfe8f8, #eaf6fb 60%); }
.tk-sun { position: absolute; top: 6%; right: 10%; width: clamp(44px, 9vw, 80px); aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff1bd; box-shadow: 0 0 40px 16px rgba(255, 241, 189, .6); }
.tk-field { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: var(--tk-ft); bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(#bfe6b4, #a8d9a0); border-top: 4px solid #9fcf94; }
.tk-furrows i { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #d9b48f; opacity: .85; }
.tk-barn { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; }
.stage .tk-barn svg, .stage .tk-tr svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.tk-plants { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.tk-pl { position: absolute; width: 56px; height: 56px; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer; }
.tk-pi { position: absolute; transform-origin: 50% 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .tk-pi svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.tk-tr { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--tk-tw); height: var(--tk-th); cursor: pointer; z-index: 2; will-change: transform; }
.tk-dr { position: absolute; left: 31%; top: 30%; width: 25%; height: 40%; min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; transform: translate(-25%, -25%); padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
.tk-barn:focus-visible, .tk-tr:focus-visible, .tk-dr:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 12px; }

/* Autobusik */
.ab { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#cfe8f8, #eaf6fb 55%, #f4eefb); }
.ab-sun { position: absolute; top: 6%; right: 10%; width: clamp(44px, 9vw, 80px); aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff1bd; box-shadow: 0 0 40px 16px rgba(255, 241, 189, .6); }
.ab-cloud { position: absolute; height: 5%; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; opacity: .85; }
.ab-c1 { left: 8%; top: 10%; width: 22%; } .ab-c2 { left: 46%; top: 18%; width: 16%; }
.ab-house, .ab-tree { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .ab-house svg, .stage .ab-tree svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.ab-sidewalk { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(var(--sy) - 4px); height: calc(var(--ry) - var(--sy) + 8px); background: #e6e0f7; border-radius: 6px; }
.ab-road { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: var(--ry); height: var(--rh); background: #b3adc9; }
.ab-dash { position: absolute; left: 3%; right: 3%; top: 58%; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #fdfbff 0 28px, transparent 28px 56px); }
.ab-stop { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 3; }
.stage .ab-stop svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.ab-bus { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--bw); height: var(--bh); cursor: pointer; z-index: 2; will-change: transform; }
.stage .ab-bus svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.ab-an { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--as); height: var(--as); min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 4; will-change: transform; }
.stage .ab-an svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.ab-stop:focus-visible, .ab-bus:focus-visible, .ab-an:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 12px; }
.rq { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#2f3a6e, #4a528f 60%, #6a62a3); }
.rq-star { position: absolute; width: 56px; height: 56px; margin: -28px 0 0 -28px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.stage .rq-star svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: block; opacity: .75; transition: none; }
.rq-planet { position: absolute; width: var(--pr); height: var(--pr); min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; margin: calc(var(--pr) / -2) 0 0 calc(var(--pr) / -2); padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
.stage .rq-planet svg { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.rq-halo { position: absolute; inset: -22%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 244, 207, .85) 38%, rgba(255, 244, 207, 0) 70%); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.rq-rocket { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--pw); height: var(--ph); cursor: pointer; z-index: 2; will-change: transform; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
.stage .rq-rocket svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.rq-rbtn { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
.rq-abtn { position: absolute; left: 52%; top: 50%; width: 24%; height: 48%; min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; cursor: pointer; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
.rq-rbtn:focus-visible, .rq-star:focus-visible, .rq-planet:focus-visible, .rq-abtn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #fff4cf; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 14px; }
.rq-puffs { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; }
.rq-puff { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; opacity: 0; will-change: transform, opacity; }

/* Mała Łódka (ld-) */
.ld { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#cfe8f8, #eaf6fb 40%, #f4eefb); }
.ld-sun { position: absolute; top: 6%; left: 12%; width: clamp(44px, 9vw, 80px); aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff1bd; box-shadow: 0 0 40px 16px rgba(255, 241, 189, .6); }
.ld-cloud { position: absolute; height: 5%; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; opacity: .85; }
.ld-c1 { left: 52%; top: 9%; width: 24%; } .ld-c2 { left: 30%; top: 19%; width: 15%; }
.ld-water { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(var(--wl) - 12%); bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(#b9e0f2, #a4d3ec); }
.ld-bank { position: absolute; border-radius: 20px 0 0 20px; background: #bfe6b4; pointer-events: none; }
.ld-wave { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; background-repeat: repeat-x; pointer-events: none; }
.ld-w1 { z-index: 1; } .ld-w2 { z-index: 3; }
.ld-jetty { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 1; }
.stage .ld-jetty svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.ld-boat { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 2; will-change: transform; transform-origin: 50% 85%; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .ld-boat > svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.ld-hull { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; }
.ld-an { position: absolute; min-width: 56px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; }
.stage .ld-an svg, .stage .ld-dk svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.ld-dk { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 4; will-change: transform; }
.ld-flip svg { transform: scaleX(-1); }
.ld-ring { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 80px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .9);
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 3; will-change: transform, opacity; }
.ld-hull:focus-visible, .ld-an:focus-visible, .ld-jetty:focus-visible, .ld-dk:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 12px; }

/* Łódź Podwodna (pd-) */
.pd { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#d3ecf8, #b5ddf0 55%, #a3cfe8); }
.pd-sand { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: var(--sh); padding: 0; border: 0; cursor: pointer; z-index: 1;
  border-radius: 40px 40px 0 0 / 20px 20px 0 0;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 18% 55%, #ead39b 0 5px, transparent 6px), radial-gradient(circle at 62% 70%, #ead39b 0 4px, transparent 5px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 45%, #ead39b 0 6px, transparent 7px), #f6e3b4; }
.pd-weed { position: absolute; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: 50% 100%; animation: pd-sway 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pd-wd1 { animation-delay: -2s; } .pd-wd2 { animation-delay: -4s; }
.stage .pd-weed svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
@keyframes pd-sway { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-3deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(3deg); } }
.pd-sub { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 3; will-change: transform; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .pd-sub > svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.pd-hull { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; }
.pd-win { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 4px solid #f4c554; border-radius: 50%; background: #e3f4fb; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: auto; }
.stage .pd-win svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.pd-fish { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 4; will-change: transform; }
.stage .pd-fish svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.pd-bub { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 5;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform, opacity; }
.pd-bub.pd-on { pointer-events: auto; }
.pd-bub span { display: block; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .45); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .9); }
.pd-hull:focus-visible, .pd-win:focus-visible, .pd-sand:focus-visible, .pd-fish:focus-visible, .pd-bub:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 12px; }

/* Kolejka Linowa (kl-) */
.kl { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#d3ecf8, #e9f5fb 60%, #f6f1e4); }

.kl-cloud { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; will-change: transform; }
.stage .kl-cloud svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.stage .kl-land, .stage .kl-cable { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .kl-land { z-index: 2; }
.stage .kl-cable { z-index: 7; overflow: visible; }
.kl-station { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 5; }
.stage .kl-station svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.kl-tree { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; z-index: 6; }
.kl-tsw { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.stage .kl-tsw svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.kl-car { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 8; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: 50% 0; will-change: transform; }
.stage .kl-car > svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.kl-hull { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; border-radius: 22px; }
.kl-an { position: absolute; width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; border-radius: 50%; }
.kl-hull:focus-visible, .kl-an:focus-visible, .kl-station:focus-visible, .kl-tree:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 12px; }

/* Balon (bn-) */
.bn { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#cfeaf8, #e6f4fb 62%, #f6f1e4); }

.bn-hull:focus-visible, .bn-an:focus-visible, .bn-cloud:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 12px; }

/* Karuzela (kz-) */
.kz { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#dff0fb, #f1f0fb 60%, #f6f1e4); }

/* Zjeżdżalnia (zj-) */
.zj { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; touch-action: manipulation;
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: linear-gradient(#cfeaf8, #f3f7e6); }
.zj-board { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 440 / 300; width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px) * 440 / 300)); }

.zj-an:focus-visible, .zj-matbtn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 16px; }
/* Huśtawka (hs-) */

  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: linear-gradient(#cfeaf8, #f3f7e6); }
.hs-board { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 400 / 300; width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px) * 400 / 300)); }
.stage .hs-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; border-radius: 24px; pointer-events: none; }

.hs-swing { position: absolute; transform-origin: 50% 0; will-change: transform; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .hs-swing > svg { position: absolute; top: 0; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.hs-seat { position: absolute; left: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.hs-an { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

.hs-treebtn:focus-visible, .hs-seat:focus-visible, .hs-an:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 16px; }

/* Zegar z Kukułką (kk-) */

  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: linear-gradient(#fdeff3, #f3ecf9); }
.kk-board { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 400 / 300; width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px) * 400 / 300)); }
.stage .kk-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; border-radius: 24px; pointer-events: none; }

.kk-door:focus-visible, .kk-hands:focus-visible, .kk-pbtn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 16px; }
/* Wiatraczki (wi-) */

  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: linear-gradient(#d4ecf8, #f6f7e4); }
```
