```css
/* Parent-only statistics screen (inside the gated overlay). */
.stats { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .8rem; }
.stats h2, .stats h3 { margin: 0; }
.stats h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin-top: .6rem; }
.panel.stats button, .stats-open { min-height: 56px; }
.stats-open { font: inherit; width: 100%; margin-top: 1.2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(120, 110, 160, .2); }
.stats-open:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 3px; }
.stats-note { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; opacity: .85; }
.stats-periods { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; }
.panel .stats-periods button { flex: 1 1 30%; min-width: 56px; padding: 0 .4rem; }
.panel .stats-periods button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #8f7fd1; color: #fff; }
.stats-dl { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: .3rem .8rem; font-size: 1rem; }
.stats-dl dt { margin: 0; }
.stats-dl dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; }
.stats-list { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.4rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .6rem; font-size: 1rem; }
.stats-list small { display: block; opacity: .85; font-size: .9rem; }
.stats-sec-title { margin: .4rem 0 .2rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; }
.stats-empty { margin: 0; opacity: .85; }

/* Rasy Piesków (rp-) and the shared dog drawings (dg-) */
.rp { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%, #f7fbe9, #e3f1d9 70%, #d3e8c0); }
.rp-wrap { position: absolute; top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 12px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 12px);
  bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 88px); }
.rp-view { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  opacity: 1; transition: opacity .5s ease; }
.rp-view.rp-pre, .rp-view.rp-out { opacity: 0; }
.rp-view.rp-out { pointer-events: none; }
.rp-dog { position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 56px; height: 100%; max-width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 6 / 5; padding: 0; border: 0;
  border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.rp-dog:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; }
.rp-dog.rp-on { background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 233, 160, .75), rgba(255, 233, 160, 0)); }
.stage .rp-dog svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.rp-name { font-size: .95rem; color: #6b6585; line-height: 1.3; padding-top: 4px; }
.rp-bubble { position: absolute; left: 62%; top: 2%; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #6b6585; font-size: 1rem;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(107, 101, 133, .25); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .3s ease; pointer-events: none; }
.rp-bubble.rp-say { opacity: 1; }
.rp-arrow { position: absolute; z-index: 5; bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); width: 64px; height: 64px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff; color: #6b6585; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(107, 101, 133, .3); cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .rp-arrow svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
.rp-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 3px; }
.rp-prev { left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 16px); }
.rp-next { right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 16px); }
@media (orientation: landscape) {
  .rp-wrap { top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 12px); bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 88px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 88px); }
  .rp-arrow { bottom: auto; top: 50%; margin-top: -32px; }
}

/* Psia Myjnia */
.pj { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#d8ecfb, #eaf6fb 60%, #d3ecea); }
.pj-field { position: absolute; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 12px);
  bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 12px); }
.pj-foam { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fff, #e6f3fb 70%); opacity: .8; pointer-events: none; }
.pj-f1 { width: 22%; aspect-ratio: 2 / 1; left: 2%; top: 2%; }
.pj-f2 { width: 16%; aspect-ratio: 2 / 1; right: 4%; top: 6%; }
.pj-f3 { width: 26%; aspect-ratio: 2 / 1; right: 10%; bottom: 2%; }
.pj-box { position: relative; outline: none; border-radius: 24px; touch-action: none; transform-origin: 50% 90%; }
.pj-box:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #8f7fd1; }
.pj-clean, .pj-mud { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.stage .pj-clean svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.pj-brush { display: none; position: absolute; width: 56px; height: 56px; margin: -28px 0 0 -28px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 3px solid #8f7fd1; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .35); pointer-events: none; }
.pj-bubbles, .pj-drops { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.pj-bub { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; aspect-ratio: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); border: 2px solid #b7deff; pointer-events: none; }
.pj-drop { position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 14px; margin: -7px 0 0 -5px; border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 65% 65% 35% 35%;
  background: #9fd0f0; pointer-events: none; }
.pj-name { height: 24px; line-height: 24px; font-size: .85rem; color: #6b6585; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

/* Wyścig Piesków */
.wp { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#d6edfb, #e9f6e4 55%, #cfe9bf); }
.wp-field { position: absolute; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
  top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 12px);
  bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 12px); }
.wp-lane { position: relative; flex: none; border-bottom: 3px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, .8); background: rgba(190, 226, 160, .35); }
.wp-lane:nth-child(even) { background: rgba(170, 214, 140, .35); }
.wp-finish { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: 10px;
  background: repeating-conic-gradient(#fff 0 25%, #5b5675 0 50%) 0 0 / 10px 10px; opacity: .85; }
.wp-puffs { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.wp-puff { position: absolute; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: -9px 0 0 -9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #efe3cf; pointer-events: none; }
.wp-dog { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; font: inherit; color: inherit; }
.wp-dog:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 0; }
.wp-art { display: block; width: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .wp-art svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.wp-name { height: 18px; line-height: 18px; font-size: .75rem; color: #6b6585; pointer-events: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.wp-confetti { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.wp-conf { position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 14px; border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; }

/* Aport */
.ap { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#cfeaf8, #e6f4fb 60%); }
.ap-sky { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: max(24%, calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px)); display: block; }
.ap-grass { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; top: max(24%, calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px)); overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(#bfe3a8, #a9d98f); border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0; }
.ap-shadow { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 36px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3d5a2f; opacity: .28; pointer-events: none; }
.ap-dog { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start;
  padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; font: inherit; color: inherit; }
.ap-dog:focus-visible, .ap-ball:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 0; }
.ap-art { display: block; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: 50% 70%; }
.stage .ap-art svg, .ap-art svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.ap-name { height: 18px; line-height: 18px; font-size: .75rem; color: #4d6a3e; pointer-events: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.ap-ball { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent;
  cursor: grab; touch-action: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.ap-ball.ap-off { cursor: default; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .ap-ball svg, .ap-ball svg { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.ap-cur { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 4px dashed #8f7fd1; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.ap-kb .ap-cur { opacity: .8; }
.ap-fx { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.ap-spark { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 12px; height: 12px; background: #ffd24a; border-radius: 2px; opacity: 0; }
.ap-heart { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 44px; height: 41px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .ap-heart svg, .ap-heart svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

/* Nakarm Pieska */
.nk { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#cfeaf8, #e6f4fb 60%); }
.nk-sky { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 40%; display: block; }
.nk-yard { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; background: linear-gradient(#bfe3a8, #a9d98f); border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0; }
.nk-table { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: #d9b48f; border-top: 8px solid #b98963; }
.nk-glow { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 244, 170, .95), rgba(255, 244, 170, 0)); }
.nk-dog { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start;
  padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; cursor: default; touch-action: none; font: inherit; color: inherit; }
.nk-art { display: block; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.stage .nk-art svg, .nk-art svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.nk-name { height: 18px; line-height: 18px; font-size: .75rem; color: #4d6a3e; pointer-events: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.nk-bowl { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; pointer-events: none; border-radius: 16px; }
.stage .nk-bowl svg, .nk-bowl svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.nk-dog.nk-over, .nk-bowl.nk-over { outline: 5px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 8px rgba(255, 226, 122, .9); }
.nk-item { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; cursor: grab;
  touch-action: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.nk-item.nk-lift { cursor: grabbing; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgba(61, 90, 47, .35)); }
.nk-item:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.stage .nk-item svg, .nk-item svg { width: 88%; height: 88%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.nk-heart { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 44px; height: 41px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .nk-heart svg, .nk-heart svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

/* Koparka */
.kg { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: #cfeaf8; }
.stage .kg-svg, .kg-svg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.kg-bucket { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; pointer-events: none; }
.kg-bucket:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.zr { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: #cfeaf8; }
.zr-sky { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(#a9dcf5, #e6f4fb 75%); }
.zr-night { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; background: linear-gradient(#1d2455, #3b3f86 80%); pointer-events: none; }
.stage .zr-stars, .zr-stars { position: absolute; left: 0; top: -60%; width: 100%; height: 160%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.zr-moon { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; width: 240%; height: 130%; margin-left: -120%; border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 14% 14% 0 0;
  background: linear-gradient(#e9e6f2, #cfcbe0); transform: translateY(-120%); pointer-events: none; }
.zr-cr { position: absolute; display: block; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(150, 144, 178, .45); }
.zr-cr1 { left: 38%; top: 5%; width: 5%; height: 6%; }
.zr-cr2 { left: 58%; top: 9%; width: 3.5%; height: 4%; }
.zr-cr3 { left: 26%; top: 12%; width: 4%; height: 5%; }
.zr-ground { position: absolute; left: -10%; top: 0; width: 120%; height: 120%; border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 10% 10% 0 0; opacity: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(#a9d98f, #8cc872); pointer-events: none; }
.zr-tray { position: absolute; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(91, 86, 117, .15); pointer-events: none; }
.zr-item { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .7); cursor: grab; touch-action: none; }
.zr-item.zr-lift { cursor: grabbing; z-index: 5; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgba(91, 86, 117, .35)); }
.zr-item:focus-visible, .zr-launch:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.stage .zr-item svg, .zr-item svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.zr-rocket { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 120px; height: 240px; transform-origin: 0 0; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .zr-rocket svg, .zr-rocket svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.zr-launch { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; visibility: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 0 22px 10px rgba(255, 226, 122, .9); transform-origin: 50% 50%; z-index: 4; }
.stage .zr-launch svg, .zr-launch svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.zr-astro { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.stage .zr-astro svg, .zr-astro svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.zr-count { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 40%; opacity: 0; font-size: min(36vw, 36vh, 220px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #fff4cf;
  text-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(61, 56, 120, .55); pointer-events: none; }
.zr-veil { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #e6f4fb; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 6; }

/* Plac Budowy */
.pb { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: #cfeaf8; }
.pb-sky { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(#a9dcf5, #e6f4fb 70%); }
.stage .pb-house, .pb-house { display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.pb-m { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff8e8; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #e2d4ae; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.pb-m:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.stage .pb-msvg, .pb-msvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }

/* Zakupy */
.zk { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: #fdf1dc; }
.zk-wall { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(#fff4d9, #fde3c0); }
.zk-floor { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: #d9b48f; border-top: 8px solid #b98963; }
.zk-top { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 12%; min-height: 48px; max-height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 12px 0 calc(var(--safe-l) + 72px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); }
.zk-list { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.zk-li { display: block; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #e2d4ae; }
.stage .zk-li svg, .zk-li svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.zk-num { min-width: 44px; text-align: center; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #6f62b0; line-height: 1; }
.zk-shelves, .zk-scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.zk-plank { position: absolute; left: 6px; right: 6px; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #c79d75; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #a8683f; }
.zk-belt, .zk-bag { position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; border-radius: 16px; }
.zk-belt { background: #8d8aa3; box-shadow: inset 0 -6px 0 #6f6c85; }
.zk-bag { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .6); border: 3px dashed #c9b8f2; }
.zk-scanner { position: absolute; height: 28px; border-radius: 14px; background: #5b5675; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #3d3a4f; }
.zk-laser { position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; top: 12px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: #e8605a; opacity: .35; }
.zk-scanner.zk-flash { box-shadow: 0 0 22px 8px rgba(63, 209, 107, .8); }
.zk-prod, .zk-item, .zk-basket, .zk-reg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; touch-action: none; cursor: grab; }
.zk-prod { border-radius: 16px; display: block; }
.zk-un { position: absolute; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.zk-ghost { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; z-index: 4; }
.zk-item { border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.stage .zk-prod svg, .zk-prod svg, .stage .zk-ghost svg, .zk-ghost svg, .stage .zk-item svg, .zk-item svg { width: 92%; height: 92%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.zk-item.zk-done { cursor: default; }
.zk-lift { cursor: grabbing; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgba(80, 60, 30, .35)); }
.zk-basket { border-radius: 16px; }
.zk-bart, .zk-bth { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; pointer-events: none; display: block; }
.zk-bn { position: absolute; right: 2px; bottom: 2px; min-width: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 0 6px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 15px; background: #6f62b0; color: #fff; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 30px; text-align: center; z-index: 60; }
.zk-bart { top: 0; bottom: 0; }
.stage .zk-bart svg, .zk-bart svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.zk-bth { top: 0; bottom: 0; }
.zk-bt { position: absolute; display: block; }
.stage .zk-bt svg, .zk-bt svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.zk-reg { border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; }
.stage .zk-reg svg, .zk-reg svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.zk-basket.zk-over { outline: 5px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 8px rgba(255, 226, 122, .9); }
.zk-prod:focus-visible, .zk-item:focus-visible, .zk-basket:focus-visible, .zk-reg:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.zk-basket:disabled, .zk-reg:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }
.zk-owner { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .zk-owner svg, .zk-owner svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.zk-receipt { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 6px; background: #fffdf5; border: 2px solid #d8cfb6; border-bottom: 6px dotted #d8cfb6; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; z-index: 3; color: #3d3a4f; }
.zk-rr { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.zk-rp { display: block; aspect-ratio: 64 / 50; }
.stage .zk-rp svg, .zk-rp svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.zk-rr b { font-weight: 700; }

/* Lot na Smoku */
.sm { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: #cfeaf8; }
.sm-canvas { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .sm-defs, .sm-defs { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; }
.sm-lt { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .sm-lt svg, .sm-lt svg, .stage .sm-ls, .sm-ls { width: 56px; height: 56px; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.sm-lt:focus-visible, .sm-kb:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.stage .sm-svg, .sm-svg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform; }
.sm-kb { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; will-change: transform; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
/* Od Jajka do… (oj-) */
.oj { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#f6f1fb, #fdf6ec); }
.oj-pic { position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; top: calc(64px + var(--safe-t)); bottom: calc(80px + var(--safe-b)); padding: 0; border: 0; background: none;
  cursor: pointer; border-radius: 28px; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; transform-origin: 50% 85%; }
.oj-pic:focus-visible, .oj-dot:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.stage .oj-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; opacity: 1;
  transition: opacity 1.2s ease; animation: oj-sway 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 50% 90%; }
.oj-in .oj-svg { opacity: 0; transition: none; }
.oj-out .oj-svg { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .6s ease; }
.oj-st { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.92); transform-origin: 150px 250px; transition: opacity 1.5s ease, transform 1.5s ease; }
.oj-st.on { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
.oj-glow { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .8s ease; }
.oj-glow-on .oj-glow { opacity: 1; }
.oj-helper { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .8s ease; }
.oj-help .oj-helper { opacity: 1; }
.oj-arm { transform-origin: 20px 32px; }
.oj-help .oj-arm { animation: oj-wave 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.oj-wig { animation: oj-wig .7s ease-in-out; }
.oj-dots { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: calc(10px + var(--safe-b)); display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; }
.oj-dot { width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.oj-dot:disabled { cursor: default; }
.oj-dotv { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 3px dashed #b8aed8; background: transparent; transition: transform .4s ease; }
.oj-dot.got .oj-dotv { border-style: solid; border-color: #8f7fd1; background: #c9b8f2; }
.oj-dot.cur .oj-dotv { transform: scale(1.3); background: #8f7fd1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff, 0 0 0 7px #8f7fd1; }
@media (orientation: landscape) {
  .oj-pic { left: calc(72px + var(--safe-l, 0px)); right: calc(72px + var(--safe-r, 0px)); top: 8px; bottom: 8px; }
  .oj-dots { left: auto; right: calc(8px + var(--safe-r, 0px)); top: 0; bottom: 0; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
}
@keyframes oj-sway { from { transform: rotate(-1.5deg) scale(1); } to { transform: rotate(1.5deg) scale(1.015); } }
@keyframes oj-wave { from { transform: rotate(-12deg); } to { transform: rotate(28deg); } }
@keyframes oj-wig { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); } 20% { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1.02); } 50% { transform: rotate(3deg) scale(1.03); } 80% { transform: rotate(-2deg); } }

/* Wędkowanie */
.wd { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: #cfeaf8; }
.stage .wd-svg, .wd-svg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.wd-rod { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; pointer-events: none; }
.wd-rod:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
/* Kulkowy Tor (mt-) */
.mt { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden;
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: linear-gradient(#dff1fb, #f8f3e1); }
.mt-board { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 400 / 360; width: min(100%, calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px - 84px) * 400 / 360)); }
.stage .mt-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; border-radius: 24px; pointer-events: none; }
.mt-rb { position: absolute; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 12px; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.mt-drop { width: 72px; height: 72px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(91, 86, 117, .25); flex: none; }
.stage .mt-dropsvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.mt-rb:focus-visible, .mt-drop:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.mt-glow .mt-track { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ffe27a) drop-shadow(0 0 10px #ffd98a); }
@media (orientation: landscape) {
  .mt { flex-direction: row; }
  .mt-board { width: min(calc(100% - 96px), calc((100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px) * 400 / 360)); }
}
/* Lustro (lu-) */
.lu { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden;
  padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px) 8px calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px); box-sizing: border-box; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#efe6fa, #fdf3f7); }
.lu-board { position: relative; flex: none; aspect-ratio: 1; width: min(100%, calc(100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px - 140px)); touch-action: none; border-radius: 24px; outline: none; }
.lu-board:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #8f7fd1; }
.stage .lu-svg, .lu-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; overflow: visible; }
.lu-canvas { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.lu-ring { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border: 3px solid #5b5675; border-radius: 50%; box-sizing: border-box; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; }
.lu-board:focus-visible .lu-ring { opacity: .8; }
.lu-ctrls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 56px); gap: 6px; flex: none; }
.lu-dot, .lu-wipe { width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; box-sizing: border-box;
  touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(91, 86, 117, .25); }
.lu-dot.lu-on { border-color: #5b5675; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 6px #8f7fd1; }
.stage .lu-dotsvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.lu-dot:focus-visible, .lu-wipe:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 3px; }
.lu-glow .lu-board { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ffe27a) drop-shadow(0 0 16px #ffd98a); }
@media (orientation: landscape) {
  .lu { flex-direction: row; padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 8px) 8px calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px) 72px; gap: 12px; }
  .lu-board { width: min(calc(100% - 192px), calc(100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 16px)); }
  .lu-ctrls { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 56px); }
}
/* Latarka */
.fl { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; cursor: none;
  --fl-x: 50%; --fl-y: 50%; --fl-r: 90px; --fl-a: .85;
  background: linear-gradient(#f6e3ef 0 62%, #e9d6b8 62% 66%, #f3e6cf 66%); }
.fl:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: -4px; }
.fl-dark { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at var(--fl-x) var(--fl-y), rgba(255, 238, 176, .22) 0, rgba(255, 238, 176, 0) var(--fl-r)),
    radial-gradient(circle at var(--fl-x) var(--fl-y), rgba(26, 22, 56, 0) calc(var(--fl-r) * .45), rgba(26, 22, 56, var(--fl-a)) var(--fl-r)); }
.fl-items { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.fl-item { position: absolute; display: block; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 3px rgba(61, 58, 79, .25)); }
.stage .fl-item svg, .fl-item svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
/* Ślady na Piasku (sp-) */
.sp { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden;
  padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px) 8px calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px); box-sizing: border-box; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#cfeaf8, #fdf3e3); }
.sp[data-scene="snow"] { background: linear-gradient(#bcd3ee, #eef4fb); }
.sp-board { position: relative; flex: none; aspect-ratio: 1; width: min(100%, calc(100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 64px - 80px)); touch-action: none; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; outline: none; }
.sp-board:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #8f7fd1; }
.stage .sp-svg, .sp-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; overflow: visible; }
.stage .sp-animal, .sp-animal { left: auto; top: auto; right: 4%; bottom: 4%; inset: auto 4% 4% auto; width: 20%; height: 20%; opacity: 0; }
.sp-canvas { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.sp-ring { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border: 3px solid #5b5675; border-radius: 50%; box-sizing: border-box; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; }
.sp-board:focus-visible .sp-ring { opacity: .8; }
.sp-ctrls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 56px); gap: 8px; flex: none; }
.sp-btn { width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; box-sizing: border-box;
  touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(91, 86, 117, .25); }
.sp-btn.sp-on { border-color: #5b5675; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 6px #8f7fd1; }
.stage .sp-btnsvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.sp-btn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 3px; }
.sp-glow .sp-under { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ffe27a) drop-shadow(0 0 14px #ffd98a); }
@media (orientation: landscape) {
  .sp { flex-direction: row; padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 8px) 8px calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px) 72px; gap: 12px; }
  .sp-board { width: min(calc(100% - 100px), calc(100dvh - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b) - 16px)); }
  .sp-ctrls { grid-template-columns: 56px; }
}

/* Rozmiar */
.rz { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#fdf3e3, #f1e2c8); }
.rz-field { position: absolute;
  top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 12px);
  bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 12px); }
.stage .rz-item { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: grab;
  touch-action: none; will-change: transform; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.stage .rz-svg { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.rz-head { position: absolute; z-index: 0; display: block; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.stage .rz-hsvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.rz-item:focus-visible, .rz-sel { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 14px; }
.rz-tgt { outline: 4px dashed #d08a2e; outline-offset: 6px; border-radius: 14px; }
.rz-lift { outline-style: dashed; }

/* Nalej Wody */
.nw { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#e6f4fb, #f7efe0 70%, #e6d3b0); }
.nw-field { position: absolute;
  top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 64px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 12px);
  bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 12px); }
.stage .nw-svg, .nw-svg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.nw-jug { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 2; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: grab;
  touch-action: none; transform-origin: 0 0; will-change: transform; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .nw-jsvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.nw-jug:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 14px; }
.nw-toast { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 3; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.stage .nw-tsvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }

/* Naklejki */
.st { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: #f4efe6; }
.st-scene { position: absolute; top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 72px); left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 8px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 8px);
  bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 216px); border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(120, 110, 160, .3); }
.st-bg, .st-items { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.st-bgb { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .8s linear; }
.st-bgb.st-in { opacity: 1; }
.st-meadow { background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 38% at 25% 104%, #8fcf72 0 98%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 34% at 85% 108%, #a9d98f 0 98%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(#cfeaf8, #eaf7e0); }
.st-sea { background: linear-gradient(to top, #f0dcaa 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(#bfe6f8 0 22%, #7ec8ef 22% 100%); }
.st-sky { background: linear-gradient(#8fc4f5, #d9ecff 68%, #fde9d0); }
.st-item { position: absolute; width: 96px; height: 96px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.st-item:focus-visible, .st-tb:focus-visible, .st-new:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 14px; }
.st-item.st-out { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .8s linear; }
.st-a, .st-b, .st-c { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.st-tray { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px); width: 270px; margin-left: -135px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 64px);
  gap: 2px 2px; justify-content: center; padding: 3px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(120, 110, 160, .25); }
.st-tray.st-full { opacity: .55; outline: 3px dashed #8f7fd1; }
.st-tb { width: 64px; height: 64px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #f6f2fb; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.st-tbi { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.stage .st-svg, .st-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.st-ghost { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 20; width: 96px; height: 96px; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(60, 50, 100, .3)); }
.st-new { position: absolute; z-index: 5; top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 8px); right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 8px); width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(120, 110, 160, .25); touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .st-nsvg, .st-nsvg { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
@media (min-aspect-ratio: 1/1) {
  .st-scene { right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 286px); bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px); }
  .st-tray { left: auto; right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 8px); bottom: auto; top: calc(var(--safe-t) + 72px); margin-left: 0; }
}
.st-pop { animation: st-pop .35s ease-out; }
.st-wig { animation: st-wig .5s ease-in-out; }
.st-c { transform-origin: 50% 85%; }
.st-m-spin { animation: st-spin 14s linear infinite; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
.st-m-sway { animation: st-sway 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.st-m-floatx { animation: st-floatx 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
.st-m-drift { animation: st-floatx 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
.st-m-bob { animation: st-floaty 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.st-m-breathe { animation: st-breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
.st-m-rock { animation: st-sway 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
.st-m-twinkle { animation: st-twinkle 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
.st-m-flutter { animation: st-flutter 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
.st-m-pulse { animation: st-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
.st-m-floaty { animation: st-floaty 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes st-pop { 0% { transform: scale(.4); } 60% { transform: scale(1.15); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
@keyframes st-wig { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); } 25% { transform: rotate(-12deg); } 75% { transform: rotate(12deg); } }
@keyframes st-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes st-sway { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-6deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(6deg); } }
@keyframes st-floatx { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-5px); } 50% { transform: translateX(5px); } }
@keyframes st-floaty { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(-4px); } 50% { transform: translateY(4px); } }
@keyframes st-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.06); } }
@keyframes st-twinkle { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(.88); opacity: .7; } }
@keyframes st-flutter { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleX(1); } 50% { transform: scaleX(.75); } }
@keyframes st-pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.1); } }

/* Pizza */
.pi { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: #fbf1df; }
.pi-wrap { position: absolute; top: var(--safe-t); left: var(--safe-l); right: var(--safe-r); bottom: var(--safe-b); }
.pi-board { position: absolute; touch-action: none; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 50%; outline-offset: 3px; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.pi-board:focus-visible, .pi-tb:focus-visible, .pi-oven:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }
.stage .pi-svg, .pi-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.pi-cust { position: absolute; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .5s linear; }
.pi-cust.pi-in { opacity: 1; }
.stage .pi-csvg, .pi-csvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.pi-tray { position: absolute; width: 204px; height: 132px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 64px); grid-auto-rows: 64px; gap: 4px; justify-content: center; align-content: center;
  padding: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(120, 110, 160, .25); visibility: hidden; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .4s linear; }
.pi-tray.pi-show { visibility: visible; opacity: 1; }
.pi-tray.pi-full { opacity: .55; outline: 3px dashed #8f7fd1; }
.pi-tb { width: 64px; height: 64px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #f6f2fb; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .pi-ico, .pi-ico { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.pi-ghost { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 20; width: 64px; height: 64px; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(60, 50, 100, .3)); }
.pi-oven { position: absolute; width: 72px; height: 72px; padding: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; visibility: hidden; opacity: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(120, 110, 160, .3); transition: opacity .4s linear; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.pi-oven.pi-show { visibility: visible; opacity: 1; }
.stage .pi-ovsvg, .pi-ovsvg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }

/* Mieszanie Kolorów */
.mx { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  background: linear-gradient(#fdf1d8, #fbe6ef 70%); }
.mx-shelf { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: #d9b48f; border-top: 8px solid #b98963; }
.mx-shelf2 { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; background: #e6c9a8; border-top: 6px solid #c9a07a; }
.mx:focus { outline: none; }
.mx-glow { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 244, 190, .95), rgba(255, 244, 190, 0) 70%); }
.mx-pot { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; pointer-events: none; border-radius: 24px; }
.mx-pot.mx-over { outline: 5px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 8px rgba(255, 226, 122, .9); }
.stage .mx .mx-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.mx-res, .mx-animal { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; }
.mx-splash { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border: 6px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; box-sizing: border-box; }
.mx-blob { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; }
.mx-blob.mx-lift { cursor: grabbing; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgba(90, 60, 40, .35)); }
.mx-blob:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #8f7fd1; outline-offset: 2px; }

/* Mój Dzień */
.md { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden;
  padding: calc(var(--safe-t) + 56px) calc(var(--safe-r) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-b) + 8px) calc(var(--safe-l) + 8px);
  background: #eaf3fb; box-sizing: border-box; }
.md-sky { position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0; width: 100%; max-width: 640px; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; background: #cfe8f7; }
.stage .md-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.md-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(72px, 1fr)); gap: 4px; width: 100%; max-width: 424px; flex: none; }
.stage .md-tile { aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 72px; min-height: 72px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.stage .md-tile svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.md-tile:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #8f7fd1; }
@media (max-height: 420px) { .md-tiles { max-width: 320px; } }

```

## File: `child-page-main/docs/activities/ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE.md`

```markdown
# [Activity display name]

> Template for activity documentation. Copy this file to `docs/activities/<kebab-case-name>.md` (lowercase, no Polish characters), replace the title and fill in every section. Delete the italic instruction lines once a section is written.
>
> Rules: document the **current implementation in the repository** only. Use exact values from the code. Do not invent values, tests, configuration or benefits. Mark missing information as `Not currently documented` or `Not implemented`. Keep planned work only in sections 18-19. Link source files with relative paths (from `docs/activities/`, e.g. `../../js/akwarium.js`) and related activities with relative links (e.g. `[Dzień i Noc](dzien-i-noc.md)`). No personal data about children, ever. No medical, therapeutic or developmental guarantees.
>
> Shared platform behaviour (no sound, global reduced-motion rule, menu configuration, analytics status, absence of automated tests) is described once in [README.md](README.md#shared-platform-behaviour); link to it instead of repeating it, and only note activity-specific deviations.

> When the activity is complete, add one linked one-line item to the main README Activities list and add the row to the docs index ([README.md](README.md#activity-index)). If the activity already has a placeholder, follow [Planned activities](README.md#planned-activities) instead.

## 1. Overview

*Include: display name, internal activity ID (`id` in `js/activities.js`), short description, activity category (calming, exploratory, matching, sorting, memory, counting, drawing, observation, coordination, cause and effect, open-ended play), target interaction type (tap, drag, trace, ...), current implementation status (e.g. Implemented; default state in the menu).*

## 2. Business purpose

*What the activity provides, why it is in the application, which user need it addresses, how it contributes to the whole application, and how it differs from or complements other activities. Be specific to this activity; avoid generic statements.*

## 3. Activity flow

*Numbered flow: 1. how it starts, 2. what is initially displayed, 3. what the child can interact with, 4. how the application responds, 5. whether there is a completion state, 6. what happens after completion, 7. how it restarts or generates another variant, 8. how the child exits. For open-ended activities state that there is no formal completion state and describe the interaction cycle.*

## 4. Rules and behavior

*Interaction rules, valid and invalid actions, randomization and selection rules, progression, success conditions, retry behaviour, animation, sound, timing, limits and thresholds, prevention of immediate repetition, weights. Give exact values (counts, grid sizes, durations, speeds, weights) taken from the code.*

## 5. Educational and developmental benefits

*Split into three labelled groups: **Intended design benefits** (e.g. attention, visual perception, counting, hand-eye coordination, cause and effect, calm observation, independent play; only those that apply), **Directly observable behavior** (what the code visibly does that relates to those intentions), **Requires professional or research-based validation** (claims that cannot be established from the code). No medical, therapeutic or developmental guarantees.*

## 6. Accessibility and usability

*Supported input (touch, mouse, stylus, keyboard if supported), portrait and landscape behaviour, responsive layout, target sizes and spacing, colour dependence and non-colour cues, contrast, sound dependence, animation intensity, reduced-motion behaviour, whether reading is required, whether a young child can use it independently. List accessibility limitations found in the current implementation.*

## 7. Risks and limitations

*Activity-specific risks: visual stimulation, rapid or flashing animation, reliance on colour, unclear or small targets, accidental interactions, repetitive content, scaling problems, performance on slow devices, activities without a clear ending, undesirable random combinations. Child-safety and privacy considerations where relevant.*

## 8. Configuration

*Table of configurable properties: name, purpose, type, default, allowed values/range, location (file and constant/function), changeable without modifying logic?, fallback when missing or invalid. If the activity has no external configuration (constants only inside its JS file), say so explicitly and list the tunable constants.*

## 9. Assets

*Activity-specific images, icons, backgrounds, illustrations, audio, animations, fonts, data files: repository path, format, purpose, naming, dimensions/aspect ratio, variants, fallback, licence/source if known. State explicitly when the activity has no external asset files (e.g. everything is inline SVG/CSS/canvas). Mention unused, duplicated or missing assets if found.*

## 10. Randomization and variants

*What is randomized, when, value pools (with sizes), whether repetition is allowed, how immediate repetition is prevented, weighted selection, whether the result persists during a session, how empty or invalid pools are handled. If nothing is randomized, say so.*

## 11. Progression and difficulty

*Initial difficulty, trigger, levels, changes between levels, maximum, reset behaviour, persistence between sessions. If there is no progression, state it explicitly.*

## 12. Completion and feedback

*Whether there is a completion state, success criteria, failure/retry behaviour, visual feedback, sound feedback (none, if silent), celebration, what happens afterwards, whether another round starts automatically. Open-ended activities: state that there is no formal completion state.*

## 13. Analytics and metrics

*Describe analytics status for this activity on the default branch, following [README.md](README.md#analytics-status). For each event type (`activity_start`, `activity_end`, `activity_complete`, `activity_restart`, `interaction`, `level_start`, `level_complete`) state whether it is emitted for this activity today, when, with which properties, whether it counts toward active time, and privacy notes. List supported metrics (starts, active time, average active time per start, completions, completion rate, replays, exit-before-completion, highest level, interactions) as supported / not supported. For open-ended activities prefer active time and interactions over a completion rate. No personally identifiable information; do not recommend collecting data that could identify a child.*

## 14. Technical implementation

*Main module and entry point, source files, state management, rendering approach (DOM/SVG/canvas), event handling, animation implementation, randomization implementation, progression implementation, configuration source, asset loading, analytics integration, shared components and utilities, dependencies, persistence, cleanup on leaving. Use file paths, function names and concise explanations; do not paste large code blocks.*

## 15. Responsive layout and coordinate system

*Supported sizes and orientations, layout rules, scaling strategy, coordinate system of static and moving elements (px, board units, percentages, viewBox, canvas logical size), handling of aspect-ratio differences, and how backgrounds, target areas and moving elements share one coordinate space.*

## 16. Error and edge-case handling

*How the activity handles: missing assets, invalid configuration, empty pools, insufficient unique items, interrupted animations, resize/orientation change, backgrounding, rapid repeated input, touch cancellation, restarting during an animation, unsupported browser features. List unhandled cases as known limitations.*

## 17. Testing

*Existing automated tests (the repository currently has none unless found), plus manual test scenarios specific to this activity: normal interaction, completion, incorrect interaction, restart/replay, randomization, progression, portrait, landscape, mobile touch, desktop mouse, background/foreground, supported browsers. Present scenarios as a checklist to be performed; do not claim a scenario was tested unless evidence exists in the repository or its PRs.*

## 18. Known limitations and open issues

*Confirmed defects, visual inconsistencies, technical debt, missing tests, missing assets, incomplete configuration, unsupported behaviour, related GitHub issues. Clearly separate **Confirmed** from **Requires verification**.*

## 19. Planned improvements

*Agreed but not yet implemented improvements, each linked to a GitHub issue where possible. `None currently planned` if there are none.*

## 20. Related activities and reusable components

*Similar activities (relative links), shared behaviour, shared components and assets (e.g. `js/animals.js`, `js/random.js`), reusable utilities, reference implementations.*

## 21. Change history

*Short activity-specific list of relevant issues and pull requests (`#NN` links to https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page). Do not duplicate the full Git history.*

```

## File: `child-page-main/docs/activities/README.md`

```markdown
# Activity documentation

One document per activity of *Spokojny Świat Artura*, describing the **current implementation on `main`** (planned work is kept apart under "Known limitations" and "Planned improvements" in each document). New documents start from [ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE.md](ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE.md). The product overview lives in the [project README](../../README.md).

*Documents were last brought in line with `main` at commit `4f83f9e` (includes PR #172 usage metrics and PR #173 visual fixes); when `main` changes an activity, update its document.*

## Shared platform behaviour

These facts apply to every activity; the activity documents link here instead of repeating them and only note deviations.

- **Loading and mounting.** `index.html` loads `js/activities.js` (the registry `window.ACTIVITIES`, each entry `{ id, name, icon, mount }`), the shared helpers, one script per activity, then `js/app.js`. An activity script replaces the placeholder `mount(container)` of its registry entry; `mount` returns an optional cleanup function. See [`js/activities.js`](../../js/activities.js) and [`js/app.js`](../../js/app.js).
- **Navigation.** URL hash routing (`#<id>`); the Back button returns to the menu (browser Back also works). `app.js` calls the activity's cleanup function and empties the stage on every exit.
- **Menu configuration.** [`js/menu-config.js`](../../js/menu-config.js) stores the enabled activities and their order in `localStorage` (key `swa.menu`); a parent edits it in the gated Settings. Each entry also carries a parent-only `fav` flag: enabled favourites show in an "Ulubione" section above the other tiles (not repeated below), and reset clears them. Disabled activities cannot be opened by any route. An entry can ship disabled with `defaultOff: true` (currently only Wiatraczki).
- **Playtime limit.** [`js/playtime.js`](../../js/playtime.js) counts visible activity time against a parent-set daily limit (default 20 minutes) and replaces the running activity with a "later" screen when time is up. Stored locally as `{ limit, used, day }` (`swa.playtime`).
- **No sound.** The application has no audio code or audio assets; activities are silent.
- **Reduced motion.** [`css/style.css`](../../css/style.css) has a global `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` rule that disables CSS animations and transitions. Activities that depend on motion for state changes drive them from a `requestAnimationFrame` loop instead; each document says which approach it uses.
- **Shared helpers.** [`js/random.js`](../../js/random.js) (`window.Rand`: `shuffle`, `pick`, `pickOne`; in-memory only) and [`js/animals.js`](../../js/animals.js) (`window.Animals`: the 13-animal SVG family with `head` and `pick`).
- **Offline/PWA.** [`sw.js`](../../sw.js) is network-first with cache fallback; no version bump is needed on deployment.
- **Automated tests.** The repository has **no automated test suite** (no unit, component, integration, end-to-end, visual or accessibility tests) and the only CI workflow ([`.github/workflows/pages.yml`](../../.github/workflows/pages.yml)) deploys to GitHub Pages. Each activity's "Testing" section therefore lists manual scenarios only. The README requires manual tests on Chrome desktop, Chrome Android and Safari iPhone/iPad.
- **Privacy.** No backend, cookies, ads, third-party requests or personal data. Only the playtime and menu settings above are stored, locally.

### Analytics status

On `main` the application has an on-device usage-metrics module, `js/analytics.js` (`window.Analytics`), introduced by issue [#164](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/164) and merged in pull request [#172](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/pull/172). It is the single place that writes analytics storage (`localStorage` key `swa.stats`: anonymous daily aggregates for 90 days plus all-time totals; no network, no per-event history, no personal data). `js/app.js` reports every activity start and end, and the module counts touches inside the stage, so **all activities listed in the index** get starts, active time, replays, quick exits (within 10 s) and touches without any code of their own. The following activities also call the module themselves (to add an activity that starts calling `Analytics`, add one row here and to the README table):

| Activity | Reports | Completion |
|---|---|---|
| **Puzzle**, **Pamięć**, **Kolorowe Kształty**, **Policz Razem** | levels (`levelStart`, `levelComplete`) and completions (`complete`) | Defined; also exit before completion and highest level |
| **Literki** | letter shown and touched (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | None |
| **Plac Budowy** | machine operated (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | None |
| **Psia Myjnia** | breed touched (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | Each clean dog (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Wyścig Piesków** | breed cheered (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | Each finished race (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Aport** | breed on each throw or dog tap (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | Each completed fetch (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Nakarm Pieska** | breed on each give attempt (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | Each full dog (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Koparka** | each scoop and tip (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | Each full truck (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Zbuduj Rakietę** | each placed part and the launch (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | Each landing (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Zakupy** | each product put in the basket and each scan (`track('interaction', { variant })`, product id) | Each fully scanned list (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Lot na Smoku** | each steering touch, fire puff and lit lantern (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | None |
| **Rasy Piesków** | each dog touch and navigation with the breed (`track('interaction', { variant })`) | None |
| **Mieszanie Kolorów** | each blob drop (`track('interaction')`, variant = colour) | each mix (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Latarka** | each first reveal of an item (`track('interaction', { variant })`, variant = item); beam moves are not reported | Each fully lit room (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Lustro** | each stroke (`track('interaction')`, variant = outline) | each glow-and-next picture (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Od Jajka do…** | each advance (`track('interaction')`, variant = cycle and stage) | each cycle that reaches its last stage (`complete()`) |
| **Pizza** | each topping placement and the oven touch (`track('interaction')`, variant = topping) | each served pizza (`complete()`) |
| **Ślady na Piasku** | each stroke start (`track('interaction')`, variant = track type) | each revealed picture (`complete()`) |
| **Kulkowy Tor** | each ramp turn and each drop (`track('interaction')`, variant = ramp or ball) | each ball in the basket (`complete()`) |
| **Nalej Wody** | each pour start (`track('interaction')`, variant = glass size) and each filled glass | each full set of glasses (`complete()`) |
| **Wędkowanie** | each lowering (`track('interaction', { variant })`, variant = catch kind) | Each five-catch set (`complete()`), open-ended |
| **Mój Dzień** | each scene start (`track('interaction')`, variant = tile) | each set of four scenes seen (`complete()`) |
| **Naklejki** | each placement (`track('interaction')`, variant = sticker) | none, open-ended |
| **Rozmiar** | each nest (`track('interaction')`, variant = item size) | each completed stack (`complete()`) |

Every other activity reports nothing itself and is open-ended. Exit-before-completion and highest level are defined only for the four levelled activities. The data is shown and exported (JSON) only in the parent-gated Settings under **Statystyki**, where it can also be reset. The "Analytics and metrics" section of each activity document states what is recorded for that activity.

## Activity index

| 60 | [Od Jajka do…](od-jajka-do.md) | `odjajka` | Touching a picture advances a four-stage life cycle (a random one of three), with dots to jump back to reached stages. | Complete |

| 62 | [Ślady na Piasku](slady-na-piasku.md) | `slady` | Dragging over sand or snow leaves one of three kinds of tracks and uncovers a hidden picture. | Complete |

## Planned activities

Activities that are agreed but not built yet have a **placeholder**: a stub page in this folder (`Status: planned (not implemented yet)`, issue link, planned id and CSS prefix, the 21 template headings), a main README list item marked "(planned)", an index row with status `planned`, and a row in both analytics tables. Status values: `planned` = placeholder only, nothing in `js/activities.js`; `Complete` = implemented and documented. The current batch is [#211](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/211) Mieszanie Kolorów, [#212](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/212) Latarka, [#213](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/213) Lustro, [#214](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/214) Od Jajka do…, [#215](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/215) Pizza, [#216](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/216) Ślady na Piasku, [#217](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/217) Kulkowy Tor, [#218](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/218) Nalej Wody, [#219](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/219) Wędkowanie, [#220](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/220) Mój Dzień, [#221](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/221) Naklejki, [#222](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/222) Rozmiar.

**Filling a placeholder.** The implementing pull request edits only its own lines: its stub page (replace the body from the template, change the status line to `Status: implemented`), its main README list line (remove "(planned)", refine the sentence), its index row (status `Complete`, remove "(planned)" from the description) and its two analytics rows (remove "(planned)", correct what it reports). It changes no other activity's text and no shared counter (there is none: intros say "all activities listed"). Placeholders do not depend on implementation order; an activity built out of order keeps its reserved number.

**Dropping or deferring an idea.** Remove its placeholder in one commit touching only its own lines (stub page, list item, index row, both analytics rows). Numbers are not closed up: the number stays a visible gap, so no other row changes. A new activity outside this batch is appended after the last row with the next free number.

**Checks.** A planned item has no entry in `js/activities.js`, so any check that compares the docs index with the menu (see [#201](https://github.com/BielinskiLukasz/child-page/issues/201)) must skip rows whose status is `planned` and exclude them from the implemented count.

Template for new activities: [ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE.md](ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE.md).

**Adding an activity:** write its document from the template, add its row to this index (there is no count to bump; if it calls `Analytics`, update its analytics row), then add one linked one-line item (`N. [**Name**](docs/activities/<file>.md) – <one sentence, no numeric parameters>`) to the Activities list in the main [README](../../README.md) (the intro states no count). Details belong only in the document. An activity that already has a placeholder follows the rules above instead (see Planned activities).

```
