```javascript
  var BALL_R = 11, OFF = BALL_R + THICK / 2;          // ball radius; centre offset above the ramp's centre line
  var VEL = 80;                                       // units/s (board height 360 -> 22% of the height per second)
  var TURN_T = 0.4, CUSHION_T = 1, ENTER_T = 0.3, GLOW_T = 3, WAVE_T = 1.6, MAX_DT = 0.05;
  var FLOOR = 336;                                    // top of the cushion
  var DROP_X = 190, DROP_Y = 26;                      // dropper hatch: left of ramp 1's centre, so a flat ramp 1 leads left
  var BASKET = { l: 250, r: 342, rim: 296 };          // opening and rim height (the ball is hidden below the rim)
  var RAMPS = [
    { cx: 200, cy: 72, col: '#f7a8c9' },
    { cx: 95, cy: 152, col: '#a8d8f0' },
    { cx: 305, cy: 152, col: '#ffd98a' },
    { cx: 200, cy: 232, col: '#9ed8c6' }
  ];
  var STATE_NAME = { '-1': 'w lewo', '0': 'płasko', '1': 'w prawo' };

  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
  function ease(t) { t = clamp(t, 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }
  function rad(d) { return d * Math.PI / 180; }

  function report(fn) { try { if (window.Analytics) { fn(window.Analytics); } } catch (e) { /* metrics must never break the activity */ } }

  function scene() {
    var s = '<defs><linearGradient id="mt-sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#dff1fb"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f8f3e1"/></linearGradient></defs>' +
      '<rect width="400" height="360" fill="url(#mt-sky)"/>' +
      '<circle cx="360" cy="70" r="30" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".55"/><circle cx="46" cy="190" r="22" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".45"/>';
    // dropper hatch and funnel at the top
    s += '<path d="M168 0H212L204 14H176Z" fill="#c9b8f2" stroke="#8f7fd1" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>' +
      '<rect x="178" y="12" width="24" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#8f7fd1"/>';
    // ramps with their posts (posts are static; the ramp bars rotate)
    var i, r;
    s += '<g class="mt-track">';
    for (i = 0; i < RAMPS.length; i++) {
      r = RAMPS[i];
```

```javascript
      var pts = [[x, y + 28]], p, h;
      for (i = 1; i <= BOWS; i++) {
        h = histAt(time - i * LAG);
        p = [x + (h[0] - x) + 4 * (i / BOWS) * Math.sin(time * 2.2 - i * 0.9), y + 28 + i * 15 + (h[1] - y)];
        pts.push([clamp(p[0], 8, BW - 8), clamp(p[1], 8, BH - 8)]);
      }
      var d = 'M' + pts[0][0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + pts[0][1].toFixed(1);
      for (i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
        d += 'Q' + pts[i][0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + pts[i][1].toFixed(1) + ' ' + ((pts[i][0] + pts[i + 1][0]) / 2).toFixed(1) + ' ' + ((pts[i][1] + pts[i + 1][1]) / 2).toFixed(1);
      }
      d += 'L' + pts[pts.length - 1][0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + pts[pts.length - 1][1].toFixed(1);
      tailP.setAttribute('d', d);
      for (i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
        var ang = Math.atan2(pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1], pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0]) * 180 / Math.PI + 90;
        bowEls[i - 1].setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + pts[i][0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + pts[i][1].toFixed(1) + ') rotate(' + ang.toFixed(1) + ')');
      }
      for (i = 0; i < cloudEls.length; i++) {
        var sc = CLOUDS[i][2] * (1 + 0.1 * Math.sin(Math.PI * (1 - clouds[i].pulse)) * (clouds[i].pulse > 0 ? 1 : 0));
        cloudEls[i].setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (CLOUDS[i][0] + clouds[i].ox).toFixed(1) + ' ' + CLOUDS[i][1] + ') scale(' + sc.toFixed(3) + ')');
      }
      if (waveT > 0) {
        var u = (WAVE_T - waveT) / WAVE_T, env = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, u * 1.15)), ang2 = Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 6);
        paw.setAttribute('cx', (21 + 3 * ang2 * env).toFixed(1)); paw.setAttribute('cy', (-14 - 22 * env).toFixed(1));
      } else { paw.setAttribute('cx', '21'); paw.setAttribute('cy', '-14'); }
      var s = k, bs = Math.max(56, 56 * s);
      kb.style.width = bs + 'px'; kb.style.height = bs + 'px';
      kb.style.transform = 'translate(' + (x * s - bs / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px,' + (y * s - bs / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px)';
    }

    function layout() {
      var w = board.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
      k = w / BW;
      var bw = Math.max(56, 60 * k), bh = Math.max(56, 64 * k);
      an.style.width = bw.toFixed(1) + 'px'; an.style.height = bh.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      an.style.left = (AX * k - bw / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      an.style.top = (AY * k - bh).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      paint();
    }

    function start() {
      if (raf || document.hidden) { return; }
      last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    function onVis() {
      if (document.hidden) { if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; } } else { start(); }
    }
    function onResize() { layout(); }

    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', onResize);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    layout();
    start();

    return function cleanup() {
      if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
      window.removeEventListener('orientationchange', onResize);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
      if (root.parentNode) { root.parentNode.removeChild(root); }
    };
  }

  (window.ACTIVITIES || []).forEach(function (a) { if (a.id === 'latawiec') { a.mount = mount; } });
})();
```

```javascript
// Activity "Literki": one big letter (Aa) on a soft card with a friendly picture of something that starts with it.
// Touch the picture: it wiggles gently and its Polish word shows small underneath for ~3 s (for the parent to read);
// touch the letter: it glows softly. Arrows (or a gentle swipe) slide to the next / previous letter;
// all 32 Polish letters in a random order (each once per round, then a new round), with a random one of several
// pictures each time. No scores, no wrong answers, no sound; nothing changes by itself.
// All motion runs in one capped-dt rAF loop (so it works under prefers-reduced-motion, where wiggle/slide are replaced
// by a soft fade); the loop stops when idle and pauses while hidden. Nothing is stored.
(function () {
  var LETTERS = window.LiterkiData || [];
  var SLIDE_S = 0.5, WIGGLE_S = 0.8, WORD_S = 3, WORD_FADE_S = 0.5, GLOW_S = 1;

  function picSvg(P) { return '<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">' + P.svg + '</svg>'; }
  function smooth(t) { t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t; return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }
  function reduced() { return !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches); }

  function mount(container) {
    container.style.display = 'block';
    var root = document.createElement('div');
    root.className = 'lt';
    root.innerHTML = '<div class="lt-field"><button type="button" class="lt-nav lt-prev" aria-label="Poprzednia litera"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M15 5L8 12l7 7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>' +
      '<div class="lt-card"><button type="button" class="lt-letter"><span class="lt-lt"></span></button>' +
      '<div class="lt-picwrap"><button type="button" class="lt-pic"></button><div class="lt-word" aria-live="polite"></div></div></div>' +
      '<button type="button" class="lt-nav lt-next" aria-label="Następna litera"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button></div>';
    container.appendChild(root);
    var card = root.querySelector('.lt-card'), letterBtn = root.querySelector('.lt-letter'),
      letterTxt = root.querySelector('.lt-lt'), picBtn = root.querySelector('.lt-pic'), wordEl = root.querySelector('.lt-word'),
      prev = root.querySelector('.lt-prev'), next = root.querySelector('.lt-next');

    var order = Rand.shuffle(LETTERS), idx = 0, slide = null, wiggle = -1, wordT = -1, glow = -1, raf = 0, last = 0;

    // Every letter once per round in random order; a new random round starts after the last letter (the first of a
    // new round is never the letter just shown). A random picture of the letter is drawn on each showing.
    function show(i) {
      if (i >= order.length) {
        var lastL = order[order.length - 1];
        order = Rand.shuffle(LETTERS);
        if (order.length > 1 && order[0] === lastL) { order.push(order.shift()); }
        i = 0;
      }
      idx = (i + order.length) % order.length;
      var L = order[idx], P = Rand.pickOne(L.pics, 'literki-' + L.l);
      window.Analytics.levelStart(0, L.l);
      letterTxt.textContent = L.u + L.l;
      letterBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Litera ' + L.u);
      picBtn.innerHTML = picSvg(P);
      picBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Obrazek: ' + P.w);
      wordEl.textContent = P.c ? P.w + ' \u00b7 ' + L.l + ' w s\u0142owie' : P.w;
      wordEl.style.opacity = '0'; wordT = -1; wiggle = -1; glow = -1;
      picBtn.style.transform = ''; letterBtn.style.filter = '';
    }
    function go(dir) {
      if (slide) { return; }          // very quick touches during the change are ignored
      slide = { t: 0, dir: dir, swapped: false };
      start();
    }
    function onPic() { window.Analytics.track('interaction', { variant: order[idx].l }); wiggle = 0; wordT = 0; start(); }
    function onLetter() { window.Analytics.track('interaction', { variant: order[idx].l }); glow = 0; start(); }

    function frame(now) {
      raf = 0;
      var dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05); last = now;
      var busy = false, rm = reduced();
      if (slide) {
        slide.t += dt; busy = true;
        var u = slide.t / SLIDE_S, op, dx = 0;
        if (u < 0.5) { op = 1 - u * 2; dx = -slide.dir * smooth(u * 2) * 60; }
        else {
          if (!slide.swapped) { slide.swapped = true; show(idx + slide.dir); }
          op = (u - 0.5) * 2; dx = slide.dir * (1 - smooth((u - 0.5) * 2)) * 60;
        }
        card.style.opacity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, op)).toFixed(3);
        card.style.transform = rm ? '' : 'translateX(' + dx.toFixed(1) + 'px)';
        if (u >= 1) { slide = null; card.style.opacity = '1'; card.style.transform = ''; }
      }
      if (wiggle >= 0) {
        wiggle += dt;
        var w = wiggle / WIGGLE_S;
        if (w >= 1 || rm) { picBtn.style.transform = ''; wiggle = -1; }
        else { picBtn.style.transform = 'rotate(' + (7 * Math.sin(w * Math.PI * 6) * (1 - w)).toFixed(2) + 'deg)'; busy = true; }
      }
      if (wordT >= 0) {
        wordT += dt; busy = wordT >= 0 || busy;
        var o = wordT < 0.25 ? wordT / 0.25 : wordT < WORD_S ? 1 : 1 - (wordT - WORD_S) / WORD_FADE_S;
        if (wordT >= WORD_S + WORD_FADE_S) { wordT = -1; o = 0; }
        wordEl.style.opacity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, o)).toFixed(3);
      }
      if (glow >= 0) {
        glow += dt;
        var g = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, glow / GLOW_S));
        letterBtn.style.filter = g > 0.01 ? 'drop-shadow(0 0 ' + (4 + 18 * g).toFixed(1) + 'px #ffe08a)' : '';
        if (glow >= GLOW_S) { glow = -1; letterBtn.style.filter = ''; } else { busy = true; }
      }
      if (busy && !document.hidden) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
    }
    function start() {
      if (raf || document.hidden) { return; }
      last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    function onVis() {
      if (document.hidden) { if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; } } else { start(); }
    }

    // gentle swipe on the card
    var sx = null;
    function sdown(e) { sx = e.clientX; }
    function sup(e) {
      if (sx === null) { return; }
      var dx = e.clientX - sx; sx = null;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 60) { go(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1); }
    }

    prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(-1); });
    next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(1); });
    picBtn.addEventListener('click', onPic);
    letterBtn.addEventListener('click', onLetter);
    card.addEventListener('pointerdown', sdown);
    card.addEventListener('pointerup', sup);
    card.addEventListener('pointercancel', function () { sx = null; });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    show(0);

    return function cleanup() {
      if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
      if (root.parentNode) { root.parentNode.removeChild(root); }
    };
  }

  (window.ACTIVITIES || []).forEach(function (a) { if (a.id === 'literki') { a.mount = mount; } });
})();
```

```javascript
// Activity "Mała Łódka": a small sailboat with 2 animals floats along a calm river. Touch the boat -> it sails / slows to a
// halt; touch the jetty -> the boat glides there and moors (only the last intent counts); touch a duck -> it nods and a
// ripple ring spreads; touch an animal aboard -> it waves. The boat never moves backwards.
// All motion is driven by one rAF loop (capped dt, paused when the tab is hidden) so it keeps working under the global
// prefers-reduced-motion rule that disables CSS animations. The boat position is a loop fraction f (0 = just off the left
// edge, 1 = just off the right edge) so speed and the mooring spot stay valid after a resize / orientation change.
(function () {
  var CROSS_S = 26;            // seconds for a full loop at cruise speed (the boat crosses the visible width in >= ~15 s)
  var V = 1 / CROSS_S;         // cruise speed, loop fractions per second
  var RAMP_S = 2.2;            // gentle start / slow-down
  var NOD_S = 2.2, WAVE_S = 2.4, RING_S = 2.6;
  var MAX_RINGS = 6;
  var MAX_DT = 0.05;
  var VB_W = 200, VB_H = 160;  // boat viewBox
  var BOB = 3;                 // bobbing amplitude in px (peak-to-peak 6px)
  var AN_X = [0.2, 0.5];       // animal centres across the boat width
  var KINDS = ['bear', 'rabbit'];
  var NAMES = ['Miś', 'Króliczek'];
  var DUCK_POS = [[0.18, 0.74], [0.5, 0.85], [0.8, 0.76]];

  function sm(u) { return u * u * (3 - 2 * u); }
  function wrap(x) { return x - Math.floor(x); }
  function clamp(x, a, b) { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x)); }

  function animalSvg(kind) {
    var fur = kind === 'rabbit' ? '#f3ecf7' : '#c99b72';
    var ears = kind === 'rabbit'
      ? '<ellipse cx="-8" cy="-26" rx="4.5" ry="12" fill="' + fur + '"/><ellipse cx="8" cy="-26" rx="4.5" ry="12" fill="' + fur + '"/>' +
        '<ellipse cx="-8" cy="-26" rx="2" ry="8" fill="#f7b7cf"/><ellipse cx="8" cy="-26" rx="2" ry="8" fill="#f7b7cf"/>'
      : '<circle cx="-13" cy="-13" r="6" fill="' + fur + '"/><circle cx="13" cy="-13" r="6" fill="' + fur + '"/>';
    var nose = kind === 'bear'
      ? '<ellipse cx="0" cy="5" rx="6" ry="4.5" fill="#f3dcc4"/><circle cx="0" cy="3.5" r="2" fill="#6b5a73"/>'
      : '<circle cx="0" cy="4" r="2" fill="#e99bb5"/>';
    return '<svg viewBox="-28 -22 56 56" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><g transform="translate(0 6)">' + ears +
      '<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="' + fur + '"/><circle cx="-6" cy="-3" r="2" fill="#5b5675"/>' +
      '<circle cx="6" cy="-3" r="2" fill="#5b5675"/>' + nose + '</g></svg>';
  }

  function boatSvg() {
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + VB_W + ' ' + VB_H + '" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">' +
      '<rect x="150" y="14" width="4" height="96" rx="2" fill="#a8946f"/>' +
      '<path d="M156 18v22l16-10z" fill="#f7a8c9"/>' +
      '<path d="M152 34L196 100H152z" fill="#fdfbff"/><path d="M148 44L106 100H148z" fill="#ffe9a8"/>' +
      '<path d="M8 104H192Q184 146 150 150H50Q16 146 8 104z" fill="#f2a98f"/>' +
      '<path d="M8 104H192L190 114H10z" fill="#fbd3c4"/>' +
      '<circle cx="120" cy="130" r="6" fill="#fdfbff" stroke="#c9a090" stroke-width="2"/>' +
      '<circle cx="150" cy="130" r="6" fill="#fdfbff" stroke="#c9a090" stroke-width="2"/></svg>';
  }

  function duckSvg() {
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 56" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">' +
      '<ellipse cx="30" cy="38" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#ffe08a"/><path d="M14 36q10 12 24 2" fill="#f7cd6a"/>' +
      '<path d="M48 22l12 6-12 5z" fill="#ffb98a"/><circle cx="44" cy="22" r="11" fill="#ffe08a"/>' +
      '<circle cx="47" cy="19" r="2.2" fill="#5b5675"/><path d="M6 34l-4-6 10 3z" fill="#ffe08a"/></svg>';
  }

  function jettySvg() {
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 220 80" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">' +
      '<rect x="0" y="0" width="220" height="16" rx="6" fill="#d9b99b"/>' +
      '<path d="M0 8H220" stroke="#c9a98a" stroke-width="2"/>' +
      '<rect x="14" y="14" width="12" height="62" rx="5" fill="#c4a483"/><rect x="104" y="14" width="12" height="62" rx="5" fill="#c4a483"/>' +
      '<rect x="194" y="14" width="12" height="62" rx="5" fill="#c4a483"/>' +
      '<circle cx="20" cy="2" r="0" fill="none"/></svg>';

  function waveUrl(col) {
    var s = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="24" viewBox="0 0 120 24"><path d="M0 12Q15 2 30 12T60 12T90 12T120 12V24H0z" fill="' + col + '"/></svg>';

  function mount(container) {
    var scene = document.createElement('div');
    scene.className = 'ld';

    scene.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Mała Łódka');

      '<div class="ld-water"></div><div class="ld-bank"></div>' +
      '<div class="ld-wave ld-w1"></div>' +

    html += '<div class="ld-boat">' + boatSvg() +

    html += '</div><div class="ld-wave ld-w2"></div>';
    for (var d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
      html += '<button class="ld-dk' + (d === 1 ? ' ld-flip' : '') + '" type="button" data-i="' + d + '" aria-label="Kaczka ' + (d + 1) + '">' + duckSvg() + '</button>';
    }
    for (var r = 0; r < MAX_RINGS; r++) { html += '<div class="ld-ring"></div>'; }
    scene.innerHTML = html;
    container.appendChild(scene);

    var boat = scene.querySelector('.ld-boat');
    var hull = scene.querySelector('.ld-hull');
    var jetty = scene.querySelector('.ld-jetty');
    var bank = scene.querySelector('.ld-bank');
    var w1 = scene.querySelector('.ld-w1');
    var w2 = scene.querySelector('.ld-w2');
    w1.style.backgroundImage = waveUrl('rgba(255,255,255,.55)');
    w2.style.backgroundImage = waveUrl('rgba(184,222,242,.9)');
    var animals = [].slice.call(scene.querySelectorAll('.ld-an')).map(function (el, i) { return { el: el, i: i, wave: -1 }; });
    var ducks = [].slice.call(scene.querySelectorAll('.ld-dk')).map(function (el, i) { return { el: el, i: i, nod: -1, x: 0, y: 0 }; });
    var rings = [].slice.call(scene.querySelectorAll('.ld-ring')).map(function (el) { return { el: el, t: -1, x: 0, y: 0, age: 0 }; });
    var ringSeq = 0;

    var W = 0, H = 0, bw = 0, bh = 0, L = 1, AS = 56, DS = 56, wl = 0, boatTop = 0, fm = 0, jw = 100;
    var f = 0, v = 0, clock = 0;
    var ramp = { v0: 0, vt: 0, t: RAMP_S, dur: RAMP_S };
    var brake = null;          // {v0, T, t, f0, sPrev}
    var target = false;        // the child asked for the jetty (only the last intent counts)
    var skip = false;          // the jetty was too close to brake for: wait until the boat has gone round
    var moored = true;
    var raf = 0, last = 0;

    function layout() {
      W = scene.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
      H = scene.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
      bw = Math.min(clamp(W * 0.42, 200, 300), H * 0.55);
      bh = bw * VB_H / VB_W;
      L = W + bw;
      wl = H * 0.56;
      boatTop = wl - bh * 0.88;
      AS = clamp(bw * 0.24, 56, 72);
      DS = clamp(H * 0.11, 56, 76);
      jw = clamp(W * 0.28, 100, 220);
      var jh = Math.max(56, bh * 0.42), jtop = wl - bh * 0.28;
      var pj = W - jw;
      var cm = Math.max(bw / 2, pj - bw * 0.4);   // boat centre when moored: always fully on screen
      fm = (cm + bw / 2) / L;
      scene.style.setProperty('--wl', wl.toFixed(1) + 'px');
      boat.style.width = bw.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      boat.style.height = bh.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      hull.style.left = (bw * 0.02).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      hull.style.top = (bh * 0.5).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      hull.style.width = (bw * 0.96).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      hull.style.height = (bh * 0.5).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      animals.forEach(function (a) {
        a.el.style.width = a.el.style.height = AS.toFixed(1) + 'px';
        a.el.style.left = (bw * AN_X[a.i] - AS / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px';
        a.el.style.top = (bh * 0.65 - AS * 0.2 - AS / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      });
      jetty.style.left = pj.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      jetty.style.top = jtop.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      jetty.style.width = jw.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      jetty.style.height = jh.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      bank.style.left = (W - jw * 0.22).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      bank.style.top = (jtop - 6).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      bank.style.width = (jw * 0.22 + 4).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      bank.style.height = (jh + 20).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      var wh = Math.max(24, H * 0.05);

        p[0].style.top = p[1].toFixed(1) + 'px'; p[0].style.height = wh.toFixed(1) + 'px';
        p[0].style.backgroundSize = (wh * 5).toFixed(1) + 'px ' + wh.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      });
      ducks.forEach(function (d) {
        d.x = W * DUCK_POS[d.i][0]; d.y = H * DUCK_POS[d.i][1];
        d.el.style.width = DS.toFixed(1) + 'px';
        d.el.style.height = DS.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      });
      if (moored && v === 0) { f = fm; }
      else if (brake) { brake = null; ramp = { v0: v, vt: V, t: 0, dur: RAMP_S }; }   // jetty moved: re-plan from the current speed, no snap
    }

  }

})();
```

```javascript
// Activity "Lustro": a big outline (butterfly, house or tree) is split by a soft dashed centre line. A finger (or arrow keys + Enter/Space)
// paints on either half and the same stroke appears at once at the mirrored position (x -> 1 - x) in the same colour and width (at least 14 px).
// Paint is clipped to the outline and kept as strokes in coordinates relative to the board, so rotation / resize only redraws the canvas.
// Painted area is measured on a 40x40 grid of the outline's cells; at 70% the picture glows for 3 s, then the next outline (shuffled bag,
// each once before repeats) fades in on a clean canvas. A round "wipe" button clears the picture with a 0.5 s fade. Only the first pointer paints.
// One capped-dt rAF loop (running only while something fades) drives all fades, so it works under prefers-reduced-motion. Nothing is stored.
// Usage metrics: track('interaction', {variant: outline id}) per stroke; complete() when the glow starts; open-ended.
```

```javascript
// Activity "Ogród Motyli": touch a flower -> the butterfly slowly flies there along a smooth curve; the flower sways.

  var FLOWERS = [

    { x: 0.74, y: 0.22, n: 8 },

    { x: 0.22, y: 0.7, n: 7 },
    { x: 0.76, y: 0.68, n: 6 }

  // a {petal, core} pair per flower, in FLOWERS order.
```

```javascript
// Activity "Pamięć": a gentle memory game of large picture cards. Game 1 deals 6 cards (3 pairs) and every completed game
// adds one pair (6, 8 ... 20 cards, max 10 pairs, then it repeats at 20); pairs are drawn at random from a pool of 14

// ~1.5 s with no shake, red or message. When all pairs are found the cards glow ~3 s, then ~4 s later they turn back
// and shuffle gently for the next game. Under prefers-reduced-motion cards cross-fade instead of turning.
// One capped-dt rAF loop (pauses when hidden, stops when idle); the card buttons are rebuilt for every game.
```

```javascript
// Activity "Mały Pociąg": touch the train -> it starts / stops gently; touch the station -> it stops there;
// touch an animal in a wagon -> it nods. All motion is driven by one rAF loop (capped dt, paused when the tab is

// and the station position stay valid when the screen size or orientation changes.
```

```javascript
// Activity "Psia Myjnia": a dog car wash. A muddy dog of a random breed (window.Dogs, never the same breed twice in a row) stands in
// the wash; dragging a finger over it scrubs the mud away (a persistent mud mask on a canvas in logical coordinates, so resize/rotation
// keeps the cleaned areas) and releases soap bubbles from a pool of 28. At ~90% clean the rest of the mud fades, the dog shakes for
// ~1 s with droplets, glows ~3 s with its Polish breed name shown small underneath, and ~4 s after being clean the next breed fades in.
// Keyboard: arrow keys move the brush, Enter/Space advance it along a zig-zag path. One capped-dt rAF loop (pauses while hidden,
// stops when idle); nothing is scored or stored. Usage metrics: track('interaction', {variant: breed}) on touches, complete() per dog.

  var DROPS = 14, DROP_S = 1;
  var DONE_AT = 0.9, FADE_MUD_S = 1.2, SHAKE_S = 1, GLOW_S = 3, NAME_S = 3, NEXT_AT_S = 4, SWAP_S = 0.7;
  var SHAKE_DEG = 6, SHAKE_HZ = 3;
  var IMG_CACHE = {}, lastId = null;

  function smooth(t) { t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t; return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }

  function report(fn) { try { if (window.Analytics) { fn(window.Analytics); } } catch (e) { /* metrics must never break the activity */ } }

  // Next breed: random from the shared list, never the previous one.

    var pool = window.Dogs.LIST.filter(function (d) { return d.id !== lastId; });
    var d = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
```

```javascript
// Activity "Rakieta": a small rocket with an animal astronaut drifts through a starry sky with three friendly planets.
// Touch the rocket -> it flies slowly along a smooth looping path; touch it again -> it slows to a hover (~2 s) and bobs.
// Touch a planet -> the rocket curves over to it (damped spring, rotated pull), hovers beside it for ~3 s while the planet
// glows softly, then resumes what it was doing. Touch a star -> one slow twinkle; touch the astronaut -> a slow wave.
// Each launch picks (Rand) one of 6 animal astronauts, one of 6 planet colour sets and one of 4 star/planet arrangements.
// All motion runs from one rAF loop (capped dt, paused when the tab is hidden) so it works under the global
// prefers-reduced-motion rule that disables CSS animations.
(function () {
  var CROSS_S = 15;             // seconds to cross the screen width at cruise speed (>= 12 s)
  var HOVER_TAU = 0.5;          // slow-down time constant (~2 s to stop)
  var BOB_AMP = 4, BOB_W = 1.9; // bob <= ~4 px each way, one bob every ~3.3 s
  var STAY_S = 3;               // time next to a planet
  var MAX_DT = 0.05;
  var MAX_PUFFS = 8, PUFF_S = 2.6, PUFF_EVERY = 0.6;

    { stars: [[0.07, 0.08], [0.30, 0.06], [0.50, 0.13], [0.72, 0.07], [0.93, 0.12], [0.38, 0.30], [0.14, 0.47], [0.90, 0.50], [0.48, 0.46], [0.28, 0.62], [0.75, 0.83], [0.92, 0.72], [0.42, 0.86], [0.06, 0.29], [0.59, 0.30]],
      planets: [[0.2, 0.2], [0.8, 0.32], [0.62, 0.68]] },

    function start() {

    var offs = [];
```

```javascript
// Shared randomisation helper for activity variety: window.Rand. Pure in-memory, stores nothing
// (no localStorage); "last pick" memory lasts only for the current page session.
(function () {
  var last = {}; // key -> last item returned by pickOne in this page session

  // Returns a new shuffled copy (Fisher-Yates); the input is not modified.
  function shuffle(list) {
    var a = Array.prototype.slice.call(list || []);
    for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      var t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
    }
    return a;
  }

  // N unique items from the pool; N >= pool size returns the whole pool shuffled;
  // a negative or non-numeric N returns [].
  function pick(list, n) {
    var a = shuffle(list);
    n = Math.floor(n);
    if (!(n >= 0)) return [];
    return n < a.length ? a.slice(0, n) : a;
  }

  // One item, never the one returned last time for the same key (pools of 2+).
  // key: any string naming the call site, e.g. an activity id. Empty pool -> undefined.
  function pickOne(list, key) {
    var a = Array.prototype.slice.call(list || []);
    if (!a.length) return undefined;
    key = key || '';
    var pool = a.length > 1 && last.hasOwnProperty(key)
      ? a.filter(function (x) { return x !== last[key]; }) : a;
    if (!pool.length) pool = a; // pool of duplicates only
    var item = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
```

```javascript
// Activity "Ślady na Piasku": a sand beach or a snowy field (alternating, never the same twice in a row) hides a picture
```

```javascript
// Activity "Lot na Smoku": a friendly green dragon with a small rider flies at constant speed to the right over a scrolling land (hills,
// a castle, sea, clouds). The scenery is one canvas whose layers scroll with a shared phase f = (t mod 60 s) / 60 and have an integer number of
// pattern periods per loop, so the 60 s loop is seamless. Three biomes (meadow, snow, sea) blend into each other smoothly, one every 36 s.
// A finger (or arrow keys) steers the dragon with a damped spring (speed capped at 60% of the screen width per second); the target and the
// dragon are always clamped so the whole dragon (wings included) stays on screen, also after a resize. Lanterns (a pool of 14, each a 56 px
// button, always 6 or more on screen) drift left; tapping a lantern or the dragon makes it breathe a short fire puff that lights the nearest
```

```javascript
// Activity "Wyścig Piesków": a friendly dog race. Four different random breeds (window.Dogs) run left to right in four lanes, each at
// its own gentle base speed (a race takes 25-35 s) and keep going untouched. Tapping a dog gives it a smooth ~1 s speed boost (+40%,
// never more than +60%) with a small dust puff. The race is never decided: from half way the dogs' speeds are blended towards one common
// finishing time, so all four finish within ~3 s of each other. Finished dogs wag their tails (happy face, Polish breed name small underneath);
// when all are in, confetti falls for ~4 s and a new race with new breeds begins. Positions are fractions of the track (rotation-safe),
// speed changes are slew-limited, one capped-dt rAF loop (pauses while hidden, stops on cleanup). Keyboard: Tab to a dog, Enter/Space cheers.
// Legs: the four legs of the shared dog (dg-legs) are regrouped per leg at the start of a race and swung about the hip from the same frame
// loop (trot: diagonal pairs alternate, 2-5 steps/s proportional to the dog's speed, small body bob); a run factor eases the swing in and out
// (legs stand again within 0.35 s of finishing). Reduced motion: half the step rate and no bob.
// Nothing is scored or stored. Usage metrics: track('interaction', {variant: breed}) on each cheer, complete() when a race is finished.
(function () {
  var LANES = 4, T_MIN = 25, T_MAX = 35;
  var BOOST_ADD = 0.4, BOOST_MAX = 0.6, BOOST_S = 1, BOOST_SLEW = 1.2;   // boost factor change per second
  var ACC = 0.02;                       // slew limit of the speed, track fractions per second squared
  var BLEND_FROM = 0.5, BLEND_TO = 0.9; // leader progress between which speeds are blended to a common finishing time
  var END_GAP_S = 2.5;                  // after the first finish nobody needs longer than this for the rest
  var CONFETTI = 36, CONFETTI_S = 4, FALL_S = 2.2, PUFFS = 12, PUFF_S = 0.55, SWAP_S = 0.7, WAG_HZ = 2.2;
  var STEPS_PER_SPEED = 70, STEPS_MAX = 5;  // steps per second = speed (track fractions/s) * 70, never above 5
  var RUN_IN_S = 0.3, RUN_OUT_S = 0.35;     // time for the leg swing to ease in at the start / out at the finish
  var BOB = 0.03;                            // body bob height as a fraction of the dog height (limit 0.04)
  var COLORS = ['#f7a8c9', '#ffd98a', '#a8d8f0', '#b6e0aa', '#c9b8f2', '#f4a261'];
  var lastSet = '';

  function smooth(t) { t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t; return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }
  function report(fn) { try { if (window.Analytics) { fn(window.Analytics); } } catch (e) { /* metrics must never break the activity */ } }

  // Four different breeds in random order; never the same set as the previous race.
  function pickBreeds() {
    var pick;
    do {
      var pool = window.Dogs.LIST.slice(), out = [];
```

```javascript
// 2 s and is then restocked with 2-4 fresh units. Dragging the basket to the counter, tapping it or pressing the checkout button brings
// the basket to the counter. Basket items are used first; list products that were not picked are added until the counter holds as many
```

```javascript
          a.paw.setAttribute('cx', (21 + 3 * ang * env).toFixed(1));
          a.paw.setAttribute('cy', (-14 - 22 * env).toFixed(1));
        } else {
          a.paw.setAttribute('cx', '21'); a.paw.setAttribute('cy', '-14');
        }
      }
      // mat: gentle bounce on touch (<= 8 px), small dip while an animal lands
      var dy = 0;
      if (matT >= 0) { dy -= MAT_BOUNCE_PX / k * Math.sin(Math.PI * matT / BOUNCE_T); }
      if (active && active.state === 'land') { dy += 3 / k * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, active.t / LAND_T)); }
      matG.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(0,' + dy.toFixed(2) + ')');
    }

    function layout() {
      var w = board.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
      k = w / BW;
      bw = Math.max(56, 60 * k); bh = Math.max(56, 80 * k);
      animals.forEach(function (a) {
        a.el.style.width = bw.toFixed(1) + 'px'; a.el.style.height = bh.toFixed(1) + 'px';
        a.svg.style.width = (60 * k).toFixed(1) + 'px'; a.svg.style.height = (80 * k).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      });
      var mw = Math.max(56, 76 * k), mh = Math.max(56, 40 * k);
      matBtn.style.width = mw.toFixed(1) + 'px'; matBtn.style.height = mh.toFixed(1) + 'px';
      matBtn.style.left = (335 * k - mw / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px'; matBtn.style.top = (258 * k - mh / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px';
      paint();
    }

    function start() {
      if (raf || document.hidden) { return; }
      last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    function onVis() {
      if (document.hidden) { if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; } } else { start(); }
    }
    function onResize() { layout(); }

    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', onResize);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    layout();

    return function cleanup() {
      if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
      window.removeEventListener('orientationchange', onResize);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
      if (root.parentNode) { root.parentNode.removeChild(root); }
    };
  }

  (window.ACTIVITIES || []).forEach(function (a) { if (a.id === 'zjezdzalnia') { a.mount = mount; } });
})();
```

```javascript
// Offline support: network-first for same-origin GETs (so a new deployment is picked up on the
// next launch with network), falling back to the cache when offline or the network is slow.
// No version bump needed on deploy: assets are re-validated against the network every time.
var CACHE = 'swa-v1';

self.addEventListener('install', function (e) {
  e.waitUntil((async function () {
    var cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
    var res = await fetch('./', { cache: 'reload' });
    var html = await res.clone().text();
    await cache.put('./', res);
    // Cache every script/stylesheet/icon index.html references, so whatever it lists works offline.
    var urls = ['manifest.webmanifest', 'icons/icon-192.png', 'icons/icon-512.png', 'icons/maskable-512.png', 'icons/apple-touch-icon.png'];
    var re = /(?:src|href)="([^":]+\.(?:js|css|png|svg|webmanifest))"/g;
    var m;
    while ((m = re.exec(html))) { urls.push(m[1]); }
    await Promise.all(urls.map(function (u) {
      return fetch(u, { cache: 'reload' })
        .then(function (r) { if (r.ok) { return cache.put(u, r); } })
        .catch(function () {});
    }));
    await self.skipWaiting();
  })());
});

self.addEventListener('activate', function (e) {
  e.waitUntil(caches.keys().then(function (keys) {
    return Promise.all(keys.filter(function (k) { return k !== CACHE; }).map(function (k) { return caches.delete(k); }));
  }).then(function () { return self.clients.claim(); }));
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', function (e) {
  var req = e.request;
  if (req.method !== 'GET' || new URL(req.url).origin !== self.location.origin) { return; }
  e.respondWith((async function () {
    var cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
    var key = req.mode === 'navigate' ? './' : req;
    try {
      var res = await Promise.race([
        fetch(req, { cache: 'no-cache' }),
        new Promise(function (_, rej) { setTimeout(rej, 5000); })
      ]);
      if (res && res.ok) { cache.put(key, res.clone()); }
      return res;
    } catch (err) {
      var hit = await cache.match(key, { ignoreSearch: true });
      if (hit) { return hit; }
      throw err;
    }
  })());
});
```

## File: `child-page-main/tools/make-icons.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the PNG app icons into icons/ (pure stdlib, no dependencies).
Usage: python3 tools/make-icons.py"""
import math, os, struct, zlib

SS = 2  # supersampling factor for smooth edges

def lerp(a, b, t): return tuple(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t for i in range(3))

def render(size, content):
    """content = fraction of the canvas the artwork may occupy (safe zone)."""
    n = size * SS
    top, bot = (200, 185, 240), (243, 238, 251)
    cx = cy = n / 2
    r_moon = n * content * 0.36
    moon = (255, 236, 179)
    stars = [(-0.30, -0.28, 0.045), (0.31, -0.18, 0.035), (0.26, 0.30, 0.04), (-0.32, 0.22, 0.03)]
    rows = []
    for y in range(n):
        row = bytearray()
        for x in range(n):
            c = lerp(top, bot, y / n)
            # crescent moon: disc minus offset disc
            d1 = math.hypot(x - cx, y - cy)
            d2 = math.hypot(x - (cx + r_moon * 0.45), y - (cy - r_moon * 0.25))
            if d1 <= r_moon and d2 > r_moon * 0.85:
                c = moon
            for sx, sy, sr in stars:
                if math.hypot(x - (cx + sx * n * content / 0.8), y - (cy + sy * n * content / 0.8)) <= sr * n * content / 0.8:
                    c = (255, 255, 255)
            row += bytes(int(v) for v in c)
        rows.append(bytes(row))
    # downsample
    out = []
    for y in range(size):
        row = bytearray()
        for x in range(size):
            acc = [0, 0, 0]
            for dy in range(SS):
                src = rows[y * SS + dy]
                for dx in range(SS):
                    i = (x * SS + dx) * 3
                    acc[0] += src[i]; acc[1] += src[i + 1]; acc[2] += src[i + 2]
            row += bytes(v // (SS * SS) for v in acc)
        out.append(b"\x00" + bytes(row))
    return out

def png(path, size, content):
    raw = b"".join(render(size, content))
    def chunk(t, d):
        c = struct.pack(">I", len(d)) + t + d
        return c + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(t + d) & 0xffffffff)
    data = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", size, size, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)) \
        + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9)) + chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    open(path, "wb").write(data)

os.makedirs("icons", exist_ok=True)
png("icons/icon-192.png", 192, 0.9)
png("icons/icon-512.png", 512, 0.9)
png("icons/maskable-512.png", 512, 0.6)   # artwork inside the 80% maskable safe zone
png("icons/apple-touch-icon.png", 180, 0.9)
```
